title: Account Executive - IT Sales (Central Florida) at Future Tech Enterprise, Inc.
description:
As a Future Tech Account Executive , you’ll be a trusted partner to mid-market and large enterprise customers, driving revenue growth and delivering innovative technology solutions. Leveraging your deep industry expertise and proven track record in selling advanced technology solutions—including PCs, storage, servers, networking, and other services —you will build and nurture strategic relationships, develop comprehensive sales plans, and consistently exceed results. 

 In this role, you will identify new opportunities, expand existing accounts, and provide consultative expertise to help clients achieve their IT goals. With your ability to engage decision-makers at all levels and a strong network of industry relationships, you’ll thrive in shaping impactful solutions that align with customer objectives. 

 This position has responsibilities that include working with government contractors; therefore, U.S. citizenship is required. 

 This remote position will be based out of and work within the Central Florida market. 

 Our benefits include Medical, Dental and Vision insurance, 401k with company match, PTO. 

 Responsibilities: 

 
 Develop a deep understanding of customers’ business objectives, IT priorities, and solution requirements. 
 Drive business growth by cultivating relationships with existing customers and establishing new partnerships through proactive engagement, including cold calling, customer meetings, and industry networking. 
 Manage and grow a portfolio of enterprise-level accounts, ensuring customer satisfaction and identifying opportunities to increase share of spend across our comprehensive portfolio of solutions, including data center, security, IT lifecycle services, hybrid cloud/ private cloud, and more. 
 Build and execute strategic account plans, including sales forecasts and pipeline management, ensuring alignment across internal and external stakeholders. 
 Serve as a trusted advisor to clients, articulating total cost of ownership, market trends, and tailored solutions to meet their goals. 
 Lead and collaborate with cross-functional teams to deliver high-impact, customized proposals and value-added solutions. 
 Represent the company at industry events, building market awareness and strengthening customer and partner relationships. 
 Continuously monitor competitive offerings and industry trends to effectively position the company’s value proposition and defend against competitors. 
 

 Qualifications: 

 
 5+ years of sales experience, with a focus on enterprise accounts and demonstrated success working at a VAR or OEM . 
 This position has responsibilities that include working with government contractors; therefore, U.S. citizenship is required. 
 Proven ability to develop and execute account strategies, build sales forecasts, and lead cross-functional teams to meet or exceed sales targets. 
 Strong network of industry relationships and ability to leverage them to drive new business. 
 Expertise in supporting various stages of the sales lifecycle, including opportunity identification, qualification, proposal development, and contracting processes. 
 Exceptional communication, negotiation, and presentation skills, with the ability to consult effectively with C-level executives and decision-makers. 
 Strong understanding of IT solutions and services, including hybrid cloud/ private cloud, data center, mobility, security, and IT asset lifecycle management. 
 Commitment to ongoing education on industry trends, products, and competitive landscape. 
 

 Why Join Future Tech 

 
 Influence the future of a rapidly evolving enterprise technology leader. 
 Collaborate with industry giants and public sector innovators to co-create impactful solutions. 
 Enjoy a dynamic, entrepreneurial culture with a clear executive mandate for innovation. 
 Competitive executive compensation and performance-based incentives.

 Future Tech Enterprise, Inc. is a recognized leader in delivering enterprise IT solutions and services to commercial, federal, and global clients. We are proud partners with technology innovators such as Dell Technologies, NVIDIA, Dell, Cisco, and others, helping our customers transform operations and drive digital modernization.

title: Sr. Business Analyst, AI & Data at Data Coach
description:
Join phData, a remote-first data and AI consultancy company with employees across the United States, Latin America, and India. We partner with industry leaders, including Snowflake, AWS, Anthropic, Glean, and dbt, to solve the complex data and AI challenges that slow large enterprises. 

 We’re growing fast, and we give our people real ownership over their work. We hire top performers and trust them to deliver results. 

 Why phData? 

 
 Snowflake Implementation Partner of the Year — 7 consecutive years, and 2026 Snowflake AI Partner of the Year 
 AWS Premier Tier Services Partner — the highest tier of recognition in the AWS Partner Network 
 2025 Fivetran Partner of the Year (4th consecutive year) 
 2025 dbt Labs Partner of the Year (3x winner) with Visionary partner status 
 2026 KNIME Customer Excellence Partner of the Year 
 Preferred Partner in the Anthropic Claude Partner Network 
 #1 Partner in Snowflake Advanced Certifications 
 600+ Expert Cloud Certifications (Sigma, AWS, Azure, Dataiku, and more) 
 Recognized as an award-winning workplace in the US, India and LATAM 
 

 You’ll act as the bridge between complex business challenges and innovative technical solutions. You will challenge the status quo, lead with AI, and guide stakeholders through AI and digital transformations to ensure every dollar spent on technology delivers measurable business value. 

 Core Responsibilities 

 Executive & Stakeholder Discovery 

 
 Lead high-impact interviews and workshops with Executives, IT, and Business Stakeholders to uncover root-cause problems and define project vision, scope, and success metrics. 
 Understand enterprise business strategy and align solutions to clear business outcomes. 
 

 Process & Value Stream Design 

 
 Map “As-Is” and “To-Be” value streams and business processes 
 Identify bottlenecks and automation/AI opportunities, distinguishing full automation from human-augmented workflows. 
 Quantify benefits (cycle time, error reduction, capacity, CSAT) to support prioritization. 
 

 Requirements for Data, AI & GenAI 

 
 Elicit, analyze, and document functional and non-functional requirements, user stories, and acceptance criteria, including for AI/ML and GenAI features. 
 Capture business rules, decision logic, and user journeys. 
 Define data requirements (sources, quality, latency, privacy constraints). 
 Specify model behavior, guardrails, and human-in-the-loop interactions. 
 Address non-functional needs (performance, explainability, auditability, SLAs). 
 

 Delivery, Change & Outcomes 

 
 Navigate complex organizational hierarchies and goals to build consensus. 
 Support experimentation and rollout (PoCs, pilots), including test design, feedback loops, training, SOP updates, and communications. 
 Partner with architects and developers to ensure designs meet business needs and oversee User Acceptance Testing (UAT). 
 Own the quality and readiness of BA deliverables and coach project team members. 
 Drive project outcomes by keeping alignment between business objectives, implementation, and success metrics. 
 

 AI-Enabled BA Practice & Client Relationships 

 
 Use Generative AI tools (e.g., Claude, Glean, agents) to accelerate analysis, documentation, and solution design—letting the tech do the heavy lifting while you validate outputs, synthesize themes, and recommend future states. 
 Establish, grow, and maintain strong customer relationships as a trusted advisor. 
 

 Qualifications 

 
 6+ years of experience in business analysis or product development in the data and analytics industry. 
 4+ years of experience in a client-facing consulting environment. 
 Demonstrated ability to facilitate interviews and workshops across multiple domains and organizational levels, translating ambiguous needs into clear, structured requirements and user stories. 
 Exceptional communication and presentation skills, able to explain complex topics to non-technical stakeholders. 
 Expertise in Agile life cycles and tools (e.g., Jira, Azure DevOps, Confluence, Visio or similar). 
 Hands-on experience leveraging AI to accelerate day-to-day BA activities in client delivery. 
 Understanding of adoption and change management approaches and familiarity with industry-standard strategy frameworks. 
 Comfortable with ambiguity, with strong curiosity for the “why” behind the “what.” 
 Proven ability to coach and mentor others and contribute to reusable BA artifacts. 
 Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.

Our approach helps us to build a winning team that represents a variety of backgrounds, perspectives, and abilities. So, regardless of how your diversity expresses itself, you can find a home here at phData. We are proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We prohibit discrimination and harassment of any kind based on race, color, religion, national origin, sex (including pregnancy), sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, veteran status, genetic information, disability, or other applicable legally protected characteristics. title: Vice President, Clinical Service Operations at Twin Health
description:
Twin Health 

 At Twin Health, we empower people to improve and prevent chronic metabolic diseases, like type 2 diabetes and obesity, with a new standard of care. Twin Health is the only company applying AI Digital Twin technology exclusively toward metabolic health. 

 We start by building a dynamic model of each person’s metabolism — drawing on thousands of data points from CGMs, smartwatches, and meal logs — that maps their personal path to better health. Guided by a dedicated clinical care team, our members have lowered their A1C below the diabetes range, achieved lasting weight loss, and reduced or even eliminated medications, all while living healthier, happier lives. 

 Working here 

 Our team at Twin Health is passionate, talented, and united by a shared purpose: to improve the metabolic health and happiness of our members. We believe in empowering every Twin to make a meaningful impact for our members, our clients, and each other, while enjoying a supportive, collaborative work environment. 

 Twin has been recognized not only for our innovation but also for our culture, including: Innovator of the Year by the Employer Health Innovation Roundtable (EHIR), selected to CB Insights’ Digital Health 150, and named one of Newsweek’s Top Most Loved Workplace® . 

 With more than $100 million raised in recent funding, including a $53 million Series E round in 2025 led by Maj Invest, and a $50 million investment in 2023 led by Temasek, Twin is scaling rapidly across the U.S. and globally. Backed by leading venture firms like ICONIQ Growth, Sequoia, Sofina, Temasek, and Peak XV, we are building the most impactful digital health company in the world. 

 Join us as we reinvent the standard of care in metabolic health. 

 Opportunity 

 The VP, Clinical Service Operations owns the operational engine driving Twin Health’s virtual practice. This leader ensures clinical supply reliably meets member demand, builds and governs the practice infrastructure that powers efficient care-team workflows, and holds full operational and financial accountability for daily practice operations. 

 A core part of the role is providing the Care Team Services that enrollment depends on, including but not limited to, reliably completing onboarding visits, staffing on-demand sensor support, and standing up the human backup that steps in when automated steps fail. Additionally this role must own the supply–demand forecasting that ensures enough care-team capacity for onboarding visits and other enrollment requirements. The Enrollment leader owns enrollment performance and its metrics; this role supports that leader by guaranteeing the care-team supply and service conditions enrollment requires. 

 This is the counterpart to Care Team Operations: Care Team Operations defines what the clinical workforce must deliver and owns care quality, care efficiency, care service level agreements, and outcomes; Clinical Service Operations makes sure the conditions for that delivery are in place — the right supply, in the right shape, at the right cost, on infrastructure that works. As the strategic operational counterpart to Care Team Operations—which defines clinical standards, care quality, service levels, and health outcomes—Clinical Service Operations ensures the foundational conditions for delivery are met: the right supply, in the right structure, at the right cost, on robust infrastructure. The VP partners closely with Care Team Operations, HR, Finance, and Product/Analytics, and manages the team responsible for practice operations and capacity readiness for new partner launches. 

 Responsibilities 

 Supply Meets Demand 

 Own the balance of clinical supply to member demand, holding utilization within a healthy 90–110% band — enough capacity to serve members reliably without costly idle time. Build and run the supply–demand model, forecast demand, and adjust staffing and scheduling to keep the system in balance as volume shifts. 

 Care Team Services for Enrollment 

 Own the Care Team Services that enrollment depends on — the supply and the operational delivery — while the Enrollment leader owns enrollment performance and its metrics. This role supports that leader; it does not own the enrollment metric. 

 
 Enrollment supply & demand. Own supply–demand forecasting for enrollment: project onboarding-visit demand and the other care-team requirements enrollment generates, and ensure enough supply — onboarding-visit slots, staffing, and coverage — is in place to meet it, so enrollment is never constrained by a lack of care-team capacity. 
 Onboarding-visit completion. Ensure the care team reliably completes scheduled onboarding visits through staffing, scheduling, backfill, and rapid recovery of missed or failed visits. 
 On-demand sensor support. Ensure on-demand sensor support is staffed and available so members can be helped through sensor setup and issues during onboarding. 
 Human backup to agents. Ensure human coverage is in place behind automated/agentic steps, ready to step in when an agent fails or cannot complete a key enrollment step — checklist, intake call, or medication reconciliation — so no member stalls at those steps. 
 

 Licensing and Credentialing Supply. Ensure human care team members have appropriate credentialing and licensing for each pod to support pod structure enrollment numbers seamlessly. 

 Clinical Supply Structuring 

 Ensure the structure of clinical supply — not just the headcount, but the mix of roles, skills, languages, licensure, and availability — meets the attributes Care Team Operations specifies. This includes maintaining active multi-state clinical licensure and credentialing compliance. Plan and flex that structure across four demand drivers: 

 
 Contractual — staffing and coverage that satisfy client contract terms, licensing, credentialing, SLAs, and performance guarantees. 
 Population-based — capacity tailored to the acuity, conditions, and needs of the member populations served. 
 Client growth — capacity planned and stood up ahead of new client and contract launches so growth never outruns supply. 
 Innovation — agile capacity allocation supporting pilots, new programs, and care-model changes. 
 

 Workforce Reliability (in Partnership with HR) 

 Partner with HR to monitor and manage care-team absenteeism and coverage, translating workforce reliability into the capacity model so that real-world availability — not just headcount on paper — is what drives supply planning. 

 Practice Infrastructure 

 Own the operational infrastructure the care organization runs on: scheduling templates, visit types, and practice reporting. Govern how visits are defined, sized, and scheduled; maintain these as a versioned, single source of truth; and deliver operational dashboards to manage the practice by metrics. Own all licensing and credentialing support for the team to ensure we have the correct licensing and credentialing supply for providers and nursing. 

 Service Reliability 

 Keep the operation dependable at the point of care, holding the daily virtual-visit loss rate under 20% — minimizing no-shows, late cancellations, and technical or workflow failures that cost a scheduled visit — through better scheduling, automated reminders, proactive backfill, and rapid resolution. 

 Financial Stewardship 

 Own operational finance for the care organization: budget planning, cost of goods sold (COGS), and headcount approval. Deliver COGS and finance reporting, manage the operation to budget, and serve as the approval gate for care-team headcount so growth stays tied to demand and unit economics. 

 How Success Is Measured 

 
 Supply-to-demand utilization sustained at 90–110% weekly. 
 Enrollment supply forecast and staffed to demand — enough onboarding-visit capacity and other care-team coverage that enrollment is never constrained by supply. 
 Onboarding visits reliably completed by the care team, with missed or failed visits backfilled and recovered. 
 On-demand sensor support staffed and available throughout onboarding. 
 Human backup to agents in place so failed or incomplete automated steps — checklist, intake call, medication reconciliation — are caught and completed by a person. 
 Supports the Enrollment leader on enrollment performance; accountable for the care-team supply and service conditions behind it, not the enrollment metric itself. 
 Supply structure meets Care Team Operations’ specified attributes across contractual, population, growth, and innovation needs. 
 Takes in monthly demand forecasts from Care Team Operations and converts that into a monthly headcount forecast, delivering “on time” supply to meet demand. (Covers provider, coach, RN, MA, MEA, L1.) 
 Daily virtual-visit loss rate held below 20%. 
 Tracks COGS and hiring plan with Finance and HR, and continuously adapts based on demand fluctuations. 
 Absenteeism monitored and factored into capacity, with coverage maintained; escalates to the Care Team Lead and HR when out of established standard for corrective actions. 
 Practice infrastructure (scheduling templates, visit types, reporting) is complete, governed, and trusted, with continuous visibility of performance metrics and detection and correction when variance falls outside expected SLAs. 
 Other duties as assigned 
 

 Qualifications 

 
 10+ years in healthcare operations, including significant experience leading virtual/telehealth or multi-site clinical operations at scale. 
 Deep workforce-management and capacity-planning expertise — supply–demand modeling, forecasting, scheduling, and staffing ratios. 
 Experience forecasting demand and delivering the care-team capacity behind an onboarding or enrollment function (onboarding visits, member/sensor support, and human coverage for automated steps), ideally in virtual care, digital health, or consumer health. 
 Track record owning an operational budget/COGS and headcount planning, with fluency in unit economics. 
 Experience building and governing practice infrastructure — scheduling systems, visit-type/appointment design, and operational reporting or dashboards. 
 Strong data fluency; runs the operation by metrics and partners effectively with analytics. 
 Comfort partnering with a growth or enrollment owner — supplying the operational capacity and service coverage they need while they own the conversion metric. 
 Proven cross-functional leadership across clinical, HR, finance, and product/technology. 
 Experience scaling operations for growth (new client/contract launches) and standing up capacity for innovation and new programs. 
 Excellent people leadership; experience managing multi-layer operational teams. 
 Ability to build independently with Claude is a plus. 
 

 Preferred 

 
 Experience in value-based care, chronic or metabolic care, or digital health. 
 Familiarity with clinical workforce tooling and telehealth delivery platforms. 
 This remote opportunity based out of the U.S. Applicants must be authorized to work for any employer in the U.S. We are unable to sponsor or take over sponsorship of an employment Visa at this time. 
 

 Compensation and Benefits 

 The compensation range for this position is $250,000 - $270,000 annually.

title: Lifecycle Marketing Operations Specialist at Denmark in USA
description:
Work Mode: Please Note: This is a Utah-based hybrid position which will require some regular in-office days each week. Additionally, employment with BambooHR is contingent on passing both a background and credit check. 

 Essential Job Duties 

 The Lifecycle Marketing Operations Manager serves as the operational arm of the Lifecycle Marketing team, helping turn strategic marketing plans into accurate, scalable programs across the prospect and customer lifecycle. This role builds, tests, launches, monitors, and updates lifecycle campaigns and supporting data processes, primarily within Marketo and related marketing systems. Working closely with lifecycle marketers and Marketing Operations partners, this role helps ensure programs are executed on time, data remains reliable, and issues are identified and resolved or escalated appropriately. This position enables lifecycle marketers to stay focused on strategy while providing the operational rigor needed to run programs end to end.

title: Lead AI Engineer, Agentic Systems - Capco AI Lab
description: We're looking for a Lead AI Engineer to join Capco's AI Frontier Lab, based in Paris. The Lab builds agentic AI solutions for clients in financial services and energy, and advises them on AI architecture and governance. The engineering team is already in place. What's missing is a senior technical lead who owns the architecture, reviews and shapes the team's work, still writes code, and can represent those technical decisions directly to the client. What you'll do Lead the engineering (~40%) Own the architecture of our agentic solutions end to end: orchestration, tool and function calling, memory and state, retrieval, evaluation, observability, plus the cost and latency budgets that decide whether a system survives contact with production. Guide our engineers through design reviews, pairing and code review, raising the bar rather than quietly doing the work for them. Set the standards: reference architectures, agentic patterns, guardrails, testing and eval strategy, CI/CD for non-deterministic systems, deployment topology. Make the build/buy/adapt calls on frameworks, models and platforms, and be able to defend them a year later. Stay hands-on (~30%) Prototype fast, and build the hard parts yourself: the tricky orchestration, the eval harness, the integration nobody else wants to touch. Take promising prototypes to production grade, covering reliability, monitoring, versioning, rollback and human-in-the-loop where it matters. Work with clients (~30%) Act as our senior technical voice in solution discussions, workshops and pitches, translating between business outcomes and system design in both directions. Advise on AI architecture, platform strategy, model and vendor strategy, and governance as they actually apply to a client's operating model. Produce content that carries weight: reference architectures, points of view, whitepapers, and talks at client forums and conferences. What we're looking for Essential 8+ years in software or data engineering, including genuine enterprise architecture experience. You've designed systems that had to survive security review, integration hell and real production traffic. You still write code, and you'd be comfortable opening a pull request in your second week. Strong Python or equivalent. Demonstrable agentic AI experience: agentic loops and orchestration, tool use and function calling, multi-agent patterns, MCP or comparable integration approaches, and, critically, how you evaluate AI solutions. Depth on at least one major cloud platform, with the surrounding discipline: containers, IaC, observability, security. Presence with clients. You can hold a room of senior stakeholders, disagree respectfully, and explain a trade-off without retreating into jargon. A real interest in making other engineers better. This role is measured partly by what the team can do without you. Valuable additions Domain experience in financial services or energy, and an understanding of what regulation means for system design in those sectors. A consulting or client-facing delivery background. Open-source contributions, publications, or a speaking track record. Hands-on AI governance, risk or assurance work. French alongside fluent English. What we offer A Lab with a real mandate and real clients. The work ships, and you'll see it running. Influence over technical direction from day one, not after a two-year wait. The rare combination of deep engineering and senior advisory work, without having to give up either. The function has been effective at launching products; what it has not yet built is the strategic layer that comes after launch – the continuous positioning, adoption strategy, and market intelligence that makes each product more valuable over time. This role owns that shift. The Director of Product Marketing and Market Research is a combined senior leadership role responsible for two things that should never have been separated: how Mews brings products to market, and how Mews understands the market it operates in. You will lead the product marketing team, own the research and customer insights function, and serve as the go-to authority on both disciplines for senior leadership across the business. Mews operates across property management, fintech and payments, guest experience, and marketplace. The right person for this role knows how to build a coherent positioning story across a complex multi-product portfolio – and how to ground that story in real market intelligence, customer insight, and competitive understanding rather than assumption. RESPONSIBILITIES Product marketing strategy Define and own product marketing strategy across the Mews portfolio – covering positioning, messaging, and go-to-market execution from launch through adoption and ongoing engagement. Build and govern the global product launch framework so that launches are scalable and repeatable, with clear handoffs between strategy and execution. Own product adoption and post-launch engagement strategy – moving the function beyond launch execution to continuous market thinking that drives usage, retention, and revenue contribution. Partner with Product, Sales, RevOps, and Customer Success to ensure product marketing strategy connects to commercial outcomes and is reflected in how the business goes to market. Own NPS tracking programs and design the measurement framework for product marketing impact, including product attach rates, adoption metrics, and pipeline contribution. Market research and customer insights Own the end-to-end market research function: identifying research opportunities, designing methodology, running studies, synthesising findings, and activating insights across the business. Lead primary and secondary research initiatives that inform strategic, commercial, and product decisions – including competitive analysis, customer behaviour, market sizing, and buyer intelligence. Build competitive intelligence as a structured, ongoing discipline – not a one-off project. Translate competitive signals into positioning decisions, sales enablement, and product roadmap input. Serve as the functional authority on what the market is telling Mews, and translate that into insight narratives that influence senior leadership decisions and business strategy. Work closely with Strategy, Product, RevOps, and Marketing to ensure insights land where decisions get made, not just where they get read. Team and function leadership Lead and develop a team of product marketers, setting clear expectations, building capability, and creating a culture of commercial accountability. Set the operating model for how the team works with AI – determining where AI handles execution tasks and where human judgment is irreplaceable, and building team-level standards accordingly. Serve as the senior leadership go-to on product marketing and market intelligence – the person any executive can trust for a well-grounded, commercially-connected answer. Represent product marketing and research in executive forums, contributing to annual planning and portfolio prioritisation decisions. REQUIREMENTS Professional knowledge and experience 10+ years in B2B SaaS marketing, with the majority of that time in product marketing – not demand generation, not agency, not brand-only roles. Has held a Director, Senior Director, or Head of Product Marketing title, or a broader marketing leadership title that included ownership of the product marketing function. Proven track record managing and developing a multi-person product marketing team, including hiring, coaching, and performance management. Experience owning or significantly contributing to a market research or customer insights function – primary research methodology, competitive intelligence programs, or voice-of-customer work. Deep understanding of B2B SaaS go-to-market strategy: positioning, messaging architecture, pricing and packaging alignment, sales enablement, and lifecycle marketing. Experience building or significantly reshaping a product marketing function – not just managing an inherited one. Has operated in a lean, fast-moving environment such as a scale-up, growth-stage, or pre-IPO company. Experience only in large enterprise environments with unlimited resources is unlikely to be a strong fit. Skills and capabilities Owns GTM strategy end-to-end – from initial positioning through post-launch adoption and continuous market engagement. Experience limited to launch execution is not sufficient. Connects product marketing directly to revenue outcomes. Can articulate how their work has influenced pipeline, product attach rates, adoption, or retention – not just campaign outputs. Translates research into business decisions – not just insight reports. Has a track record of research that changed a strategic or commercial direction. Multi-functional marketing experience beyond product marketing, for example content, SEO, digital, demand generation, or go-to-market strategy. Metrics-driven. Comfortable defining and owning the measurement framework for both product marketing impact and research quality. Strong senior stakeholder communication. Able to influence executive decisions, present with authority, and earn trust through substance rather than seniority alone. Publicly visible in the product marketing or insights community – speaker, writer, or recognised contributor to the discipline. Not a requirement, but a meaningful differentiator. AI fluency AI is changing the product marketing function in a way that is more structural than any other recent technology shift. A significant part of this role is deciding what that means for the team at Mews – what AI handles, what stays human, and how to build a team that operates at a higher strategic level as execution work is automated. We expect this person to: use AI tools deliberately and with criteria; describe specific examples of AI changing how they or their team works strategically; have a point of view on where the product marketing function is heading as AI matures; and build team-level standards for AI use, including how to review and quality-control AI-assisted outputs before they reach senior stakeholders or customers. NICE TO HAVE Fintech, payments, or financial services product marketing experience. Hospitality, travel tech, or hotel SaaS background. Both fintech and hospitality in one profile is the strongest possible combination for this role. Global market experience. Experience in a company that has undergone a go-to-market transformation. title: Director, Product (M/F/X)
description: Rejoins une superstar de la foodtech française Chez HelloFresh, nous bousculons les habitudes alimentaires des français grâce à nos Box à cuisiner ! Notre ambition ? Révolutionner le quotidien de nos abonnés, en promouvant une façon plus durable de cuisiner et en leur faisant découvrir de délicieuses recettes, créatives et équilibrées. L’alliance parfaite entre technologie et gastronomie, pour un maximum de gourmandise.s HelloFresh est présent dans plus de 15 pays. La France, un jeune marché lancé en 2019, connaît une ascension fulgurante : nous y sommes déjà leaders depuis 2021. Le moment parfait pour rejoindre notre équipe et avoir un impact fort dans l'une des scale-ups françaises les plus prometteuses ! Comment rendre tout cela possible ? Grâce à une équipe talentueuse et dynamique, des valeurs fortes de bienveillance et de diversité, et un environnement de travail stimulant. Si tu souhaites prendre part à cette incroyable aventure humaine, internationale et entrepreneuriale, rejoins-nous ! L'opportunité: HelloFresh France place le produit au cœur de sa croissance, et ce rôle en est le moteur. En tant que Directeur(rice) Produit, vous piloterez une équipe pluridisciplinaire couvrant le culinaire, le développement recettes, l'innovation produit et l'analytique, avec la responsabilité pleine et entière de ce qui se retrouve au menu chaque semaine : les ingrédients que nous sélectionnons, les concepts que nous créons, et les arbitrages commerciaux qui les sous-tendent. Cela implique la gestion directe du budget coût des marchandises et la responsabilité de son impact sur le compte de résultat. C'est un rôle concret et exigeant, à la croisée de l'alimentaire, de la stratégie et des opérations, là où la qualité du produit est ce qui fidélise nos clients. Vos missions: Construire et développer une équipe produit performante Fédérer, inspirer et manager une équipe pluridisciplinaire — en posant une vision claire, en instaurant des rythmes de travail qui permettent d'avancer vite, et en investissant dans les personnes qui porteront le prochain chapitre de HelloFresh France. Définir et challenger la vision produit Construire une vision claire et ambitieuse de ce que doit devenir notre produit physique — ancrée dans la connaissance client, rigoureuse sur le plan commercial, et suffisamment différenciante pour gagner. Développer un point de vue propre et indépendant, nourri des insights de l'équipe Produit globale, mais enraciné dans la réalité du marché français. Garantir l'accès aux informations, analyses et données nécessaires pour prendre des décisions éclairées en matière de développement produit, et traduire la vision en actions concrètes. Pousser l'équipe et l'entreprise à aller au-delà de la feuille de route actuelle — en remettant en question les hypothèses, en interrogeant les arbitrages, et en s'assurant que nous travaillons toujours sur ce qui a le plus d'impact. Piloter la rétention client et la performance commerciale Faire de la rétention client votre boussole. Construire une vision rigoureuse et fondée sur les données de ce qui la détermine, et mobiliser l'équipe autour des actions qui font vraiment la différence. Prendre des décisions produit en ayant pleinement conscience de leurs implications financières. Prendre des risques calculés, mesurer les résultats honnêtement, et ajuster rapidement quand un pari ne fonctionne pas. Collaborer étroitement avec les équipes Opérations (Achats, Qualité, Production, etc.) pour assurer une approche coordonnée des initiatives produit, à l'échelle locale comme globale. Aligner produit et stratégie marketing Travailler main dans la main avec l'équipe brand & marketing pour que la feuille de route produit et la stratégie marketing soient pleinement synchronisées — ce que nous construisons, comment nous en parlons et comment nous le vendons doivent former une proposition cohérente. Être la voix du produit au sein du comité de direction, en portant une vision convaincante de là où le produit doit aller et pourquoi. Votre profil: Expérience : 8 à 10 ans minimum dans le Produit, la Stratégie ou un rôle de leadership commercial similaire, idéalement dans l'alimentaire, le FMCG, les meal kits ou l'abonnement. Outils : Maîtrise avancée d'Excel / Google Sheets et de PowerPoint / Google Slides ; curiosité et aisance avec l'IA indispensables. Leadership : Au moins 3 ans de management d'équipes pluridisciplinaires à différents niveaux de carrière — avec un vrai sens du coaching, une direction claire et l'envie de faire grandir les gens Un(e) leader qui passe à l'action. Vous donnez le cap, vous emmenez votre équipe avec vous, et vous mettez la main à la pâte pour que ça se concrétise. Orienté(e) client et rigoureux(se) dans l'analyse. À l'aise pour interroger vos propres données et challenger vos hypothèses. Capable d'aller dans le détail, de faire le lien avec la vision d'ensemble, et de restituer les insights avec clarté. Orienté(e) business. Vous comprenez comment les décisions produit se répercutent sur les coûts et les revenus — et vous vous tenez responsable des résultats, pas seulement des réalisations. Fédérateur(rice) transversal(e). Vous installez rapidement la confiance, faites avancer les choses par l'influence, et savez inscrire les bonnes priorités dans les agendas des autres équipes. Bon(ne) résolveur(se) de problèmes — à l'aise dans l'ambiguïté, déterminé(e) à trouver des solutions, avec un réflexe naturel pour l'action. Excellent(e) communicant(e). Vous écrivez et présentez avec clarté et conviction — que ce soit pour un narratif stratégique, une mise à jour pour le leadership ou un brief produit. Organisé(e) et structuré(e) , avec de solides compétences en gestion de projet et la capacité à tenir des délais serrés. Passionné(e) de food , avec la capacité à transformer les tendances et les signaux marché en offres produit attractives. Ce que nous t’offrons : Un environnement dynamique et international, avec une culture d'entreprise forte Une courbe d’apprentissage rapide garantie ! Une équipe française bienveillante, passionnée, proactive et dynamique Des bureaux au cœur de Paris, dans le 1er arrondissement Nos avantages : de délicieuses réductions sur nos Box HelloFresh, tickets restaurant Swile, réduction sur le transport, un accès privilégié à Gymlib Le déroulé du processus de recrutement : Nous examinons ton CV et ta lettre de motivation. Si c’est un match, nous t’invitons à une série d’entretiens et à réaliser un case study. Nous nous engageons à organiser rapidement les entretiens, afin de t’accueillir chez HelloFresh au plus vite ! Tes débuts chez HelloFresh : A ton arrivée, nous te concoctons des sessions d’onboarding qui te permettront de rencontrer chaque manager et de t’imprégner ainsi du fonctionnement de HelloFresh. Tu auras aussi du temps pour faire plus ample connaissance avec ton équipe avant de plonger dans le vif de tes missions ! Find Jobs in France on Arbeitnow

title: Senior Platform Engineer - ARTESCA
description: About Scality: Scality solves organisations’ biggest data storage challenges: growth, security, performance, and cost. Designed for end-to-end cyber resilience, only Scality S3 object storage with CORE5 safeguards data at every level of the system, from API to architecture. Its patented MultiScale Architecture enables limitless, independent scalability in all critical dimensions to meet the unpredictable demands of modern workloads. The world’s most discerning companies depend on Scality to accelerate high-performance AI initiatives, optimize cloud deployments, and defend their data with confidence. Recognized as a leader by Gartner, Scality software is reliable, secure, and sustainable. Follow us on LinkedIn . Visit www.scality.com and our blog . The Job Context We are looking for engineers who can own, maintain and evolve the platform and tooling that power ARTESCA — Scality’s cyber-resilient S3 storage, allowing our customers to get immutable, zero-trust backup storage that scales from 20TB to petabytes. You’ll be integrated in a team of ~7 people with varied backgrounds (production operations, pure development, security, product management…) ranging from 3 to 30+ years of experience, all willing and able to share their experience to contribute to your technical and human growth, and to benefit from your experience as well. You will be taking part in MK8s open source project ( https://github.com/scality/metalk8s ). Inside the team, we have specific roles and plenty of growing paths for you: Individual contributor: everybody participates in the daily work of the team. Feature lead: to accompany a feature from design to delivery. Technical lead: to be the reference point for a specific perimeter in the product. Architect: to lead feature designs and make sure we stay aligned with the technical strategy of the company. Product owner: to decide priorities and build the roadmap. Team leader: acting as a manager, to be responsible for the work environment in general, from approving holidays to sharing company strategy throughout solving day-to-day issues. The Technical Stack K8S / Docker / Containerd knowledge / Helm, Operator SDK Go (Golang) : Core language for high-performance components and Kubernetes Operators. RPM packaging Salt Prometheus, Grafana, Keycloak, Thanos, Loki, Fluent-bit, Cert-manager, Calico, Multus, KubeVirt RHEL/Rocky Python / Bash PostgreSQL databases Git / GitHub / Github Actions as CI AWS/Scaleway/OVH for virtual labs Main Mission: What you’ll do Build and maintain the platform behind ARTESCA: the Operating System and Kubernetes control plane, workers, add-ons, and solutions that underpin ARTESCA in its various deployment options (Software Appliance, Hardware Appliance, and ARTESCA+ Veeam all-in-one). Harden security and compliance: CIS benchmarks, SBOM, supply-chain tooling (e.g. Dependency-Track/Anchore), and secret management — directly supporting ARTESCA’s cyber resilience and Cyber Guarantee. Contribute to installer and product workflows: multi-node/HA deployment, state management, pre-checks, and cloud/vendor integrations (e.g. AWS, VmWare) for guided deployment and validated backup vendor integrations (Veeam, Cohesity, Commvault, Rubrik, and others). Own upgrades and lifecycle: Kubernetes versions, Helm charts, operators, and base images so the product stays secure, simple to deploy, and ready for high availability and fast restores. Write and maintain documentation (operations, install, solutions) and tests (integration, upgrade, stability) so ARTESCA stays intuitive, low-touch and recovery-ready at scale. Improve CI/CD: GitHub Actions, devcontainers, diff-based or cost-aware CI, and release automation to release reliably. AI-Assisted Engineering We actively use AI tools (including Claude Code and similar) as part of our engineering workflow. description: About the team The Value Proposition & New Benefits team owns what our core value proposition for subscription should be, and the new benefits that bring it to life. How do we prioritise and sequence a pipeline of benefit ideas against limited engineering, design, and operational capacity? Track ongoing performance - maintain visibility into each live benefit's impact on acquisition, retention, frequency, and satisfaction against its cost to serve, flagging when something needs attention. Scale what works - take benefits from small pilots to steady-state features, defining the operating model, reporting cadence, and processes needed to run them sustainably. Bring outside-in perspective - track what Uber One, DashPass, Wolt+, Just Eat and Amazon Prime are doing with membership benefits, and translate what's relevant into Deliveroo's context. Communicate to senior stakeholders - write clear strategy documents and present recommendations, trade-offs, and results to leadership. Requirements 5+ years of experience in strategy & operations, strategy consulting, or business operations - ideally with exposure to marketplaces, subscription/membership businesses, or consumer tech. Commercial acumen : strong understanding of marketplace dynamics and subscriber value; comfortable building a business case and owning a set of P&L-adjacent metrics. title: Director of Product Marketing and Market Research
description: Help make the world more hospitable The hospitality industry is uniquely human, and it deserves technology that’s just as inspiring as the people behind it. At Mews, we’re transforming the industry with a platform that helps hotels run smarter, move faster and create better guest experiences. You’ll work with smart, curious people who care deeply about what they do. You’ll have autonomy and the trust to make good decisions and move quickly. And you’ll enjoy a real sense of purpose as you see the impact of what we’re building. If you’re motivated by ownership, curiosity and meaningful impact, and are driven to deliver consistent high performance, you’ll feel at home here. About the role Let's get into the specifics. It’s impossible to capture every nuance of a role – especially at a rapidly growing company like Mews – but if we had to distil it into a job description (which we do because this is a job description), it would be this: POSITION OVERVIEW Product marketing at Mews is at a turning point. The function has been effective at launching products; what it has not yet built is the strategic layer that comes after launch – the continuous positioning, adoption strategy, and market intelligence that makes each product more valuable over time. This role owns that shift. The Director of Product Marketing and Market Research is a combined senior leadership role responsible for two things that should never have been separated: how Mews brings products to market, and how Mews understands the market it operates in. You will lead the product marketing team, own the research and customer insights function, and serve as the go-to authority on both disciplines for senior leadership across the business. Mews operates across property management, fintech and payments, guest experience, and marketplace. The right person for this role knows how to build a coherent positioning story across a complex multi-product portfolio – and how to ground that story in real market intelligence, customer insight, and competitive understanding rather than assumption. RESPONSIBILITIES Product marketing strategy Define and own product marketing strategy across the Mews portfolio – covering positioning, messaging, and go-to-market execution from launch through adoption and ongoing engagement. Build and govern the global product launch framework so that launches are scalable and repeatable, with clear handoffs between strategy and execution. Own product adoption and post-launch engagement strategy – moving the function beyond launch execution to continuous market thinking that drives usage, retention, and revenue contribution. Partner with Product, Sales, RevOps, and Customer Success to ensure product marketing strategy connects to commercial outcomes and is reflected in how the business goes to market. Own NPS tracking programs and design the measurement framework for product marketing impact, including product attach rates, adoption metrics, and pipeline contribution. Market research and customer insights Own the end-to-end market research function: identifying research opportunities, designing methodology, running studies, synthesising findings, and activating insights across the business. Lead primary and secondary research initiatives that inform strategic, commercial, and product decisions – including competitive analysis, customer behaviour, market sizing, and buyer intelligence. Build competitive intelligence as a structured, ongoing discipline – not a one-off project. Translate competitive signals into positioning decisions, sales enablement, and product roadmap input. Serve as the functional authority on what the market is telling Mews, and translate that into insight narratives that influence senior leadership decisions and business strategy. Work closely with Strategy, Product, RevOps, and Marketing to ensure insights land where decisions get made, not just where they get read. Team and function leadership Lead and develop a team of product marketers, setting clear expectations, building capability, and creating a culture of commercial accountability. Set the operating model for how the team works with AI – determining where AI handles execution tasks and where human judgment is irreplaceable, and building team-level standards accordingly. Serve as the senior leadership go-to on product marketing and market intelligence – the person any executive can trust for a well-grounded, commercially-connected answer. Represent product marketing and research in executive forums, contributing to annual planning and portfolio prioritisation decisions. REQUIREMENTS Professional knowledge and experience 10+ years in B2B SaaS marketing, with the majority of that time in product marketing – not demand generation, not agency, not brand-only roles. Has held a Director, Senior Director, or Head of Product Marketing title, or a broader marketing leadership title that included ownership of the product marketing function. Proven track record managing and developing a multi-person product marketing team, including hiring, coaching, and performance management. Experience owning or significantly contributing to a market research or customer insights function – primary research methodology, competitive intelligence programs, or voice-of-customer work. Deep understanding of B2B SaaS go-to-market strategy: positioning, messaging architecture, pricing and packaging alignment, sales enablement, and lifecycle marketing. Experience building or significantly reshaping a product marketing function – not just managing an inherited one. Has operated in a lean, fast-moving environment such as a scale-up, growth-stage, or pre-IPO company. Experience only in large enterprise environments with unlimited resources is unlikely to be a strong fit. Skills and capabilities Owns GTM strategy end-to-end – from initial positioning through post-launch adoption and continuous market engagement. Experience limited to launch execution is not sufficient. Connects product marketing directly to revenue outcomes. Can articulate how their work has influenced pipeline, product attach rates, adoption, or retention – not just campaign outputs. Translates research into business decisions – not just insight reports. Has a track record of research that changed a strategic or commercial direction. Multi-functional marketing experience beyond product marketing, for example content, SEO, digital, demand generation, or go-to-market strategy. Metrics-driven. Comfortable defining and owning the measurement framework for both product marketing impact and research quality. Strong senior stakeholder communication. Able to influence executive decisions, present with authority, and earn trust through substance rather than seniority alone. Publicly visible in the product marketing or insights community – speaker, writer, or recognised contributor to the discipline. Not a requirement, but a meaningful differentiator. AI fluency AI is changing the product marketing function in a way that is more structural than any other recent technology shift. A significant part of this role is deciding what that means for the team at Mews – what AI handles, what stays human, and how to build a team that operates at a higher strategic level as execution work is automated. We expect this person to: use AI tools deliberately and with criteria; describe specific examples of AI changing how they or their team works strategically; have a point of view on where the product marketing function is heading as AI matures; and build team-level standards for AI use, including how to review and quality-control AI-assisted outputs before they reach senior stakeholders or customers. NICE TO HAVE Fintech, payments, or financial services product marketing experience. Hospitality, travel tech, or hotel SaaS background. Both fintech and hospitality in one profile is the strongest possible combination for this role. Global market experience. Experience in a company that has undergone a go-to-market transformation. title: Software Architect
description: At NiCE, we don’t limit our challenges. We challenge our limits. Always. We’re ambitious. We’re game changers. And we play to win. We set the highest standards and execute beyond them. And if you’re like us, we can offer you the ultimate career opportunity that will light a fire within you. Lead Software Architect At NICE, we don’t limit our challenges. We challenge our limits. Always. We’re ambitious. We’re game changers. And we play to win. We set the highest standards and execute beyond them. And if you’re like us, we can offer you the ultimate career opportunity that will light a fire within you. Why this role matters now This role sits at the centre of our AI-led delivery transformation. We are rebuilding our digital evidence platform as AI-Native, with AI tooling acting as a daily partner from design through verification. The right architect is not someone with a long list of AI credentials - AI moves too fast for credentials to mean much. The right architect is someone who already uses AI in their daily work, has formed clear judgement about where it belongs and where it does not, and is curious enough to learn the next tool when their current one is superseded. So, what’s the role all about? We are looking for a talented Architect and Software Developer to join our team. You must: Be able to communicate effectively, including via email, instant message, phone, and video conferencing tools. Be fierce in your pursuit of product quality. Be an excellent problem solver with an active interest in the latest design and development tools and technologies. Be knowledgeable and enthusiastic about process. Be practically fluent with AI tooling - using Copilot, Claude Code, Codex or equivalent in your daily work, not just experimentally. We will discuss specific examples at interview. Be able to recognize opportunities for optimization and enhancement of process, product architecture and delivery based on the evolutions in AI. Have clear judgement about where AI belongs in a public-safety platform, and where it does not. How will you make an impact? You will be responsible for: Owning the architecture, and carrying out design, AI-led implementation and validation in Cloud-based, multi-threaded, multi-server environments -working in our AI-led delivery method where code, tests and decisions are AI-drafted, with you setting intent, orchestrating implementation, and validating outputs. Leading technical decisions on architectural direction using a collaborative, team-based approach. Ensuring the architecture takes into account the concerns of security, scalability, compatibility, maintainability — and the responsible, evidenced use of AI in both build-time and run-time. Performing testing of your work, fixing defects, and helping to resolve customer support cases. Ensuring that the team adheres to the architectural direction and standards. Mentoring and coaching team members in architecture practices, AI-led delivery techniques, and the discipline of validating AI outputs. Liaising with Product Management during planning sessions. Have you got what it takes? Solid experience developing applications in C# using Visual Studio/Visual Studio Code. Proven track record of breaking down complex market requirements into secure, scalable and resilient system designs. Experience with multi-tenant cloud solutions. Experience working in collaborative multidisciplinary teams. Experience creating maintainable code and using source control solutions such as DevOps, GIT or similar. Experience of unit testing, code reviews, and other product quality disciplines. Solid understanding of the principles of network security, authentication, and authorization. Experience of working with databases using Entity Framework or similar. Good knowledge of SOLID principles. Experience creating RESTful APIs and ensuring API extensibility. Recent practical experience using AI tooling (Copilot, Claude Code, Codex or equivalent) in your daily work, not just experimentation. Comfortable describing what worked, what did not, and what you decided. Output discipline: you remain accountable for the architecture you are responsible for, whatever helped you produce it. Comfort with probabilistic systems, and clear judgement about when to use AI in a high-trust domain. Learning velocity: able to ramp on a new AI tool or technique in days, not months. You will have an advantage if you also have: Security best practice (OWASP top ten) Azure SQL Server DevOps, Pipelines, TeamCity, GitHub Windows services Experience using AI tooling specifically in the architect role - for design review, ADR drafting, threat modelling, contract design, or similar. Familiarity with AI-Native software patterns (agentic workflows, evaluation harnesses, prompt-and-response evaluation, evidence packets). What we do not require We do not require you to be an AI expert. AI moves too fast for credentials to mean much. We require curiosity, recent practical use, output discipline, and the judgement to ship under accountability. About the interview process The final stage includes a working session using our AI tooling. The aim is to see how you think - how you set intent, validate outputs, and make decisions - not to test memorised knowledge. You love to build clarity out of complexity and champion high-impact technical products from concept to launch. title: Team Lead Software Production Support (m/f/d)
description: At Quantum Systems, we are redefining the boundaries of autonomous drone technology. We develop and deploy some of the world’s most advanced UAVs, combining highly integrated hardware, embedded software, sensors, compute platforms, and production processes into reliable systems for demanding real-world missions.​ As part of our Software Production Support Team, you will work at the intersection of serial UAV production, embedded software, firmware deployment, production diagnostics, automation, and traceability. You will help ensure that every drone leaving production is equipped with the correct software, firmware, configuration, and documentation needed for safe and reliable operation.​ Between hands-on troubleshooting on the production floor, flashing microcontrollers and compute modules, analyzing system behavior, improving diagnostic workflows, developing production tools, and refining digital work instructions, you will play a key role in turning advanced UAV technology into stable, scalable, and efficient serial production What is your Day to Day Mission: Leading and developing the Software Production Support team​. Prioritizing urgent production support topics and long-term improvement activities​. Identifying bottlenecks, recurring issues, and process weaknesses in serial production​. Defining robust processes for microcontroller flashing, NVIDIA Orin installation, firmware updates, diagnostics, and recovery workflows​. Driving automation and standardization of software-related production steps​. Ensuring that production tools are reliable, versioned, documented, and maintainable​. Defining requirements for production traceability and digital paper trail documentation​. Coordinating software-related production escalations with Engineering, Quality, and Industrialization​. Ensuring that Operations1 work instructions are technically correct and reflect the real production process​. Monitoring KPIs such as production downtime, flashing success rate, recurring issues, and software-related first-pass yield​. Turning production issues into sustainable process, tooling, or engineering improvements. What you bring to the team: Several years of experience in embedded systems, production software, manufacturing test, industrialization, or technical production support​. Experience in serial production or manufacturing environments​. Strong understanding of embedded software, firmware flashing, production diagnostics, and system integration​. Experience with Linux-based embedded systems, ideally NVIDIA Jetson / Orin or similar platforms​. Hands-on experience with scripting, automation, production tooling, and diagnostic workflows​. Ability to analyze complex issues across software, electronics, tooling, process, and operator interaction​. Experience coordinating or leading technical teams​. Strong communication skills across production operators, engineers, quality teams, and management​. A structured, hands-on mindset with the ability to distinguish one-off production issues from systemic process weaknesses​. Ideally, experience in drones, robotics, aerospace, automotive, defense, or industrial electronics​. Ideally, knowledge of CAN, UART, Ethernet, USB, SWD, JTAG, I2C, SPI, MES, ERP, traceability systems, or Operations1. Why Quantum-Systems: We believe in the power of combined efforts: straightforward tech expertise paired with a customer-centric focus. We are industry pioneers who are ambitious, bold, and visionary. We push limits, think outside-the-box and strive for technological excellence to shape the future of aerial data. We promise to be your runway for individual and professional growth. Our benefits: Company pension scheme: We support you so that you can already make provisions for later. Flexible working hours: With trust-based working hours, you are not only responsible for your working hours, but also for your work-life balance. Mobile working: If it gets too turbulent for you in our office, you can get the necessary balance through mobile working. Bike-Leasing: We support you in staying environmentally mobile and healthy. Corporate Benefits: Your opportunity for attractive offers and discounts from well-known suppliers and brands, e.g. Adidas, Apple, Expedia. Employee events: We not only want to grow together, but also celebrate our successes together. Lunch-Card: Be powerful with delicious energy, daily lunch budget is sponsored. Company Shuttle: Enjoy our convenient shuttle service that picks you up from Pasing in Munich and brings you to our location, with return trips at the end of the workday. About us: Quantum Systems specialises in the development, design, and production of small Unmanned Aerial Systems (sUAS). The company’s range of electric vertical take-off and landing (eVTOL) sUAS are built to maximize range and versatility and to provide operators with a seamless user experience. By integrating cutting-edge software capabilities, like edge computing and real-time AI-powered data processing, Quantum Systems is building next-generation UAS for clients in defence, security, public sectors. Regardless of gender, age, ethnic origin, religion, sexual orientation or disability, we firmly believe that the diversity of our employees is an essential part of our success. At our company, every voice is heard and every perspective is valued. We believe that our differences enrich us and help us to find creative solutions and generate innovative ideas. We pride ourselves on creating an inclusive work environment where all employees can reach their full potential. Find more English Speaking Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

title: Account Executive (m/w/d) Legal Tech – DACH
description: Where Legal Leads. Drei Worte. Eine Überzeugung. Rechtsabteilungen sind nicht länger die Bremse im Unternehmen – sie sind der Hebel. Bei DiliTrust geben wir ihnen die Plattform, die diesem Anspruch gerecht wird: Verträge, Beteiligungen, Vorstandsarbeit und Legal AI – eine integrierte Suite für die gesamte Rechtsfunktion. Im Einsatz bei mehr als 3.000 Unternehmen in 64 Ländern, darunter führende Konzerne in Europa, Nordamerika und MEA. DACH ist unser nächster großer Wachstumsmarkt. Die Basis steht, jetzt skalieren wir . Du übernimmst ein eigenes Territory, baust deine Strategie eigenständig auf und entscheidest, wo du wachsen willst – unterstützt von einem Team aus Solution Consultants, BDR, Marketing und Customer Success, das in DACH bereits liefert. Der Legal-Tech-Markt ist über 16 Milliarden Dollar schwer und wächst jedes Jahr zweistellig. In zwei Jahren wirst du auf diesen Moment zurückblicken. Die Frage ist nur: Warst du dabei? Deine Rolle Du verantwortest ein eigenes Vertical in DACH, z.B. Financial Services, Energy, Manufacturing oder Pharma. Dein Fokus liegt auf Neukundengewinnung und gezieltem Cross-Sell in deinem bestehenden Portfolio. Du identifizierst und qualifizierst neue Opportunities, gemeinsam mit deinem BDR, über Anfragen, Marketing und gezielte Ansprache. Du arbeitest strukturiert, nicht aus dem Bauch. Du baust deinen Territory Plan auf, entwickelst Account Plans für deine Top-Targets und treibst gemeinsam mit deinem BDR fokussierte Pod Sprints in deinem Vertical. Deine Deals liegen typischerweise zwischen 50.000 € und 200.000 € Jahresvolumen. Sales-Cycles dauern 4–9 Monate. Pro Deal sprichst du mit 4–7 Entscheidern: Legal, IT, Einkauf, Finance, manchmal Vorstand. Du verkaufst eine Plattform, kein Einzelprodukt. Erstgespräche führen oft Legal Ops Manager oder General Counsel. Deals über mehrere Module sind bei uns die Regel. Du repräsentierst DiliTrust auf den wichtigen Branchen-Events wie z.B. Legal Revolution oder LegalTech. Du führst dort die Gespräche, die später zu Pipeline werden. Must-have 4+ Jahre Erfahrung im quotaverantwortlichen B2B-Software-Vertrieb, idealerweise im SaaS-Umfeld. Erfahrung in komplexen Sales-Cycles mit mehreren Entscheidern aus Legal, IT, Finance oder Procurement. Methodisches Arbeiten: Du qualifizierst sauber (z. B. mit MEDDPICC) und führst belastbare Forecasts. Erfahrung im Verkauf an C-Level-Entscheider. Deutsch auf Muttersprachen-Niveau, sehr gutes Englisch – unsere Unternehmenssprache ist Englisch. Nice-to-have Erfahrung im Verkauf an Rechts-, Governance- oder Compliance-Funktionen. Du kennst die Welt regulierter Branchen - Financial Services, Energy, Healthcare oder Pharma. Du hast bereits eigenständig ein Territory aufgebaut – mit klarer Account-Strategie und nachhaltigem Pipeline-Aufbau. Du interessierst dich für KI im Unternehmenskontext und kannst Kunden den Unterschied zwischen Hype und echtem Mehrwert erklären. Was wir dir bieten Remote-First. Du arbeitest von zuhause oder in unseren Offices in München und Berlin - regelmäßige Team-Events bringen uns offline zusammen. Onboarding und Ramp-Up, das zu einem komplexen Produkt passt. Produkt, Branche und Methodik step by step - mit erfahrenen Teamkollegen, die dich auf Tempo bringen. Ehrliches Coaching, präsenter Sales Manager. Wir sind 7 Leute im DACH-Sales, keine Nummer in einer großen Maschine. Regelmäßige Einzelgespräche, gemeinsame Deal-Reviews. Wenn du gut bist, wird das gesehen. Wenn etwas hakt, wird darüber gesprochen. Karriereperspektive in einer Wachstumsregion. Senior AE, Enterprise AE, Team Lead DACH: wir bauen die Region aktiv aus, nicht ab. Internationales Setup, lokaler Fokus. Dein Spielfeld ist DACH, aber wenn dich die Lust auf Mailand, Madrid oder Mexico City packt, kannst du auch von dort arbeiten. 30 Tage Urlaub, Zulage für Heimarbeit und weitere Vorteile folgen in Kürze! Dein Weg zu uns Erstgespräch mit dem Recruiting-Team (30 Min, auf Englisch) – wir lernen uns kennen, klären gegenseitige Erwartungen. Interview mit dem Sales Manager DACH (45 Min) – Deep Dive in deine Erfahrung, deine Methodik und Fit für die Rolle. Interview mit dem Global Chief Sales Officer (45 Min) – Strategie, Karriereperspektive, Final-Check. Kurzes Rollenspi el (45 Min) – eine realistische Sales-Situation, an der wir sehen, wie du arbeitest. Du bekommst Briefing und Vorbereitungszeit. Bist du bereit, bei uns einzusteigen? Schick uns einfach deinen Lebenslauf – wenn möglich auf Englisch – ein Anschreiben ist nicht erforderlich. Wenn du vorab Fragen hast: ----- oder sende eine LinkedIn-Nachricht an Fabian Pohl. Wir freuen uns über Bewerbungen von allen, unabhängig von Geschlecht, Alter, Herkunft, Religion, sexueller Identität oder Behinderung. Hinweis: Wir nutzen KI-gestützte Tools zur Vorauswahl von Bewerbungen. Die endgültige Entscheidung trifft immer ein Mensch. Find more English Speaking Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

description: Du bist Profi in der Metallbearbeitung und willst nicht nur ausführen, sondern Verantwortung im Fertigungsprozess übernehmen und dein Team aktiv mit voranbringen Dann werde Teil der FMA Freitaler Metall und Anlagenbau GmbH . FMA - Freitaler Metall- und Anlagenbau GmbH · Poststr. 23 · 01705 Freital Deine Mission: In der FMA-Freitaler- Metall- und Anlagenbau GmbH trägst du in der Anarbeitung eine zentrale Verantwortung dafür, dass aus Rohmaterial präzise gefertigte Stahlbauteile entstehen, die die Grundlage für unsere gesamte Schweißbaugruppenfertigung bilden. Deine Verantwortung: Operative Fertigung in der Anarbeitung Verantwortung für die gesamte operative Vorfertigung in der Anarbeitung als Grundlage für die Schweißbaugruppenfertigung. Dabei arbeitest du aktiv in der Bearbeitung von Stahlbauteilen mit und stellst sicher, dass Qualität, Maßhaltigkeit und Prozessvorgaben eingehalten werden. Teamverantwortung und Mitarbeiterentwicklung in der Anarbeitung Fachliche Verantwortung im Tagesgeschäft der Anarbeitung mit aktiver Steuerung der Aufgabenverteilung im Team sowie Sicherstellung eines stabilen Fertigungsablaufs durch kontinuierliche Abstimmung und Unterstützung bei technischen Entscheidungen. Zusätzlich Verantwortung für die strukturierte Einarbeitung neuer Mitarbeiter sowie die Förderung fachlicher Kompetenzen und die Entwicklung eigenverantwortlicher Arbeitsweisen im Team mit dem Ziel einer schnellen und nachhaltigen Integration in den Fertigungsprozess. Kontinuierliche Prozessverbesserungen Mitwirkung bei der Analyse und Optimierung bestehender Fertigungsprozesse zur Steigerung der Effizienz, Reduktion von Durchlaufzeiten und Verbesserung der Qualität in Abstimmung mit der Fertigungsleitung. Schnittstellenarbeit mit Produktion und Technik Enge Abstimmung mit Arbeitsvorbereitung, Produktionsleitung und Qualitätssicherung zur Sicherstellung effizienter Abläufe und termingerechter Fertigung mit hoher Qualität. Dein Profil: Abgeschlossene Berufsausbildung im Metallbereich z.B. title: Senior GTM Systems AI and Automation Engineer
description: Camunda is the enterprise platform for agentic orchestration , enabling organizations to coordinate AI agents, people, and systems across complex, end-to-end business processes. With built-in governance, auditability, and human oversight, Camunda gives enterprises the control they need to move AI from pilots to production — safely and at scale. Trusted by over 700 organizations worldwide , including 9 of top 10 US banks, Camunda helps enterprises boost operational efficiency, accelerate time-to-value, and deliver better customer experiences. Fully remote and global, we are in the middle of something bigger: transforming into an AI-first organisation, built on our own platform . We use Agentic AI to automate, orchestrate intelligent processes, and elevate human contribution across every team. Named GP Bullhound’s Top 100 Next Unicorn list, 2025 Great Place to Work certified. Visionary in 2025 Gartner® Magic Quadrant™ for Business Orchestration and Automation Technologies. ranked 3rd in Flexa's 2026 Most Flexible Companies , We’re growing fast and looking for top talent to join our team. If you want meaningful work, visible impact and put something genuinely rare on your CV, keep reading. About the Role: Camunda's Revenue Operations organization is looking for a Senior GTM Systems AI and Automation Engineer to design, build and operate the AI-powered infrastructure that connects our go-to-market systems and removes manual work across Sales, Customer Success, Marketing, Partnerships and Account Development. You will join the GTM Systems team – a small group of builders who own a Salesforce-centric revenue stack – and take ownership of its AI and automation layer: agents, LLM integrations, MCP servers, retrieval pipelines, backend services and workflow orchestration. You will partner with GTM leaders to find high-impact problems, scope them, and ship reliable, well-governed solutions iteratively. This is a fully remote role and can be based anywhere we are eligible to hire. What You Will Do: Design, build and operate AI agents, LLM integrations and automations that connect Salesforce, Gainsight, Slack, Salesloft, Clari, HubSpot, Impartner and the rest of the GTM stack – reducing manual work across Sales, CS, Marketing, Partners and ADR teams. Own the architecture of the GTM Systems AI layer: MCP servers, APIs, retrieval and context pipelines, reusable agent tools and skills, and serverless or containerized services on Google Cloud Platform (BigQuery, Cloud Run, Cloud Functions). Ship production-grade LLM capabilities – prompt engineering, RAG, function calling, structured outputs, automated evaluations – with the guardrails to match: validation, fallback logic, confidence thresholds, human escalation paths, access controls, audit logging, and cost and latency management. Partner with Revenue Operations, Sales, Customer Success, Marketing, Partnerships and SDR/ADR leaders to identify and prioritize automation opportunities, translate ambiguous requirements into maintainable solutions, and deliver incrementally with clear documentation. Raise the engineering bar for the GTM Systems team: code review, automated testing, CI/CD, security governance, observability and technical documentation; mentor teammates on responsible AI-assisted development. Design and deploy workflows on orchestration platforms such as Camunda and Clay, and create playbooks and enablement so GTM teams can use and operate automations independently. What You Will Bring to the Role: Must Haves: 5+ years of software engineering experience (backend development, systems integration, data or analytics engineering, or automation), including at least 2 years shipping LLM or AI capabilities into production business workflows or internal tools. Strong proficiency in Python and JavaScript/TypeScript (Node.js), with mature Git-based development habits: code review, automated testing, CI/CD. Hands-on command of LLM patterns – prompt engineering, RAG, function/tool calling, structured outputs, model evaluation – and of their failure modes and mitigations (validation, fallback logic, confidence thresholds, human review, cost and latency control). Experience integrating with Salesforce (REST/Bulk/Streaming APIs, data model, platform limits; Apex or Flow a plus) and other business systems via APIs and event-driven patterns, and with a cloud platform (GCP preferred: BigQuery, Cloud Run, Cloud Functions, IAM). Ability to own a problem end-to-end with minimal guidance – scope, design, deliver, operate – and to communicate clearly with engineering and business stakeholders in a remote, asynchronous environment. Nice to Haves: Experience with the Model Context Protocol (MCP) or similar standards for connecting AI systems to tools and data; agent frameworks; vector databases or retrieval pipelines (pgvector, Pinecone, Weaviate, ChromaDB). Exposure to AI observability and evaluation tooling (LangSmith, Weights & Biases, or custom eval frameworks). Familiarity with orchestration platforms such as Camunda or Clay, and prior work in Revenue Operations, GTM Systems, Sales Operations or Marketing Operations in B2B SaaS. Building lightweight interfaces for AI tools (React, Slack Block Kit, dashboards); Salesforce certifications (Platform Developer I/II, Integration Architect). This role is an existing vacancy #LI-JS1 #LI-DNI What We Have to Offer: Compensation We offer competitive, fair, and transparent compensation. Salary ranges are location-based, with Standard and Major markets (global tech hubs) reflecting local competition. The Annual Total Target Cash (base salary + 100% variable target, where applicable) shown below spans from the minimum in a Standard market to the maximum in a Major market. Final offers depend on skills , experience , and location , and we typically hire in the first half of the range to allow room for growth: United States: $143,800.00 to $231,900.00 United Kingdom: £90,300.00 to £148,500.00 Singapore: S$178,600.00 to S$267,900.00 If you’re based elsewhere, you’ll be hired via Remote.com (our global employer partner), and your Talent Acquisition Partner will provide a personalized Total Rewards Calculator after your first interview. Equity: We also offer equity (where applicable) through our Virtual Stock Option Plan (VSOP) . Benefits & Perks We invest in your wellbeing, growth, and ability to connect, along with perks that support you no matter where you’re based. Our benefits are globally designed and locally delivered where applicable. Remote & Flexible: Work from anywhere with the setup that suits you, home office budget, co-working space support, and flexible time off to recharge when you need it. In Person Connection: We invest in meaningful face time through our Annual Kickoff (Vienna in 2025, Madrid in 2026!), team offsites, and Camundi Connection Budgets , including contributing to meetups while travelling,, and local gatherings with fellow Camundi. Health & Wellbeing: Access locally tailored healthcare, Modern Health for global mental wellbeing, and our Live Well Lifestyle Spending Account (LSA), a flexible, global benefit that puts you in control of your whole life, not just work, from: staying active, to caring for family, exploring personal passions, meaningful experiences, and investing in your financial wellbeing. The Live Well program launches in 2026 and scales to €1,000 annually from 2027 . Financial Security: Retirement and pension plans (often with company contributions), plus life and disability insurance where relevant. Professional Growth: Up to $/€/£1,000 per year for self-driven learning: courses, certifications, books, you decide! At Camunda, we honour diverse cultures and backgrounds and are proud to be an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration without regard to gender, race, ethnicity, religion, belief, sexual orientation, age, disability or any other protected characteristics under applicable law. We are looking forward to your application! Come join us and be part of Camunda’s incredible journey: Make an impact at a pivotal moment in our story!
