title: System Engineer Linux-Infrastruktur & Virtualisierung (m/w/d)
description: Standort: Remote (deutschlandweit) oder Hybrid – Office Bad Lippspringe, 10 Min. von Paderborn Beschäftigungsart: Vollzeit, unbefristet Start: ab sofort – wir warten nicht auf das nächste Quartal Über reisewitz reisewitz entwickelt seit 1984 intelligente Planungssoftware und ist europaweit für seine Kunden im Einsatz. Mit adelo® (Tourenplanung & Workforce Management), optaflow® (mobile Zählerkommunikation) und aures (automatische Disposition) steuern über 150 Kunden ihre Serviceteams – darunter Hardeck, BoConcept, Wiener Netze und zahlreiche Stadtwerke. Wir sind ISO 27001 zertifiziert und wurden 2024 mit dem Sust-Award für nachhaltige Routenplanung ausgezeichnet. Unsere Software liefern wir nicht als Datenträger aus, sondern als Service — wir hosten sie selbst. Deine Mission Du betreust unser Hosting-Geschäft — als die Person, die diesen Bereich übernimmt, mit klar abgegrenztem Verantwortungsbereich und direktem Draht zum CIO. Die Plattform, auf der unsere Kunden täglich ihre Touren planen und ihre Monteure steuern, läuft auf Infrastruktur, die du verantwortest: eine wachsende Hetzner-VPS-Landschaft , unsere Virtualisierungsumgebungen samt Firewall sowie die dazugehörigen Netz-, Storage- und Backup-Schichten. B2spin: Digital Design Team Lead — Retention/CRM
description: Headquarters: Bulgaria URL: http://b2spin.com We are B2Spin, and we are dedicated to delivering the best Free-to-Play Social Casino and gaming experiences by creating captivating, engaging, and unique products that are accessible to everyone. We have built a team of talented professionals from all over the globe, who are working to continually improve the experiences of our players. We are not looking to just be part of the industry, but to revolutionize it. The Role We run the creative function for retention at a multi-brand iGaming company. That means high-volume, high-frequency output — emails, push notifications, in-app messages, onsite banners — produced for segmented player audiences across multiple brands, all at the same time. This is a marketing creative leadership role, not a product or UX design role. You will lead a team of Digital Designers producing retention marketing assets across four brands and multiple CRM channels — not app or product interfaces. The Design Team Lead owns the quality and consistency of that output. Not by reviewing everything personally, but by building the systems, standards, and team capability that make good work the default. This is as much an ops-and-systems role as it is a creative leadership role. If you're energized by turning "we eyeball it every time" into "we have a standard for that," this is the job. What You Will Own Brand systems that actually get used Our brands are fragmented today. You'll build the documented visual systems — templates, component libraries, per-brand rules, practical "do this, not that" guidance — that designers reach for rather than work around. When the system is good, consistency stops being something we police and becomes the default. Repeatable production at scale Multiple designers producing work across four brands and CRM channels need modular templates, clear briefing standards, and clean versioning. You'll build and maintain those foundations. Just as importantly, you'll convert the feedback you keep repeating into checklists and onboarding material — so nobody gives the same note twice. AI that produces on-brand results, not surprises We already use AI heavily; the results aren't predictable enough. You'll put structure around it: per-brand prompt libraries, locked reference styles, clear review checkpoints, and training on how to take a raw AI output and finish it to a genuinely on-brand standard. Quality that can be measured You'll define what "on-brand and high quality" means for each brand, track simple signals like first-pass approval rate and rework volume, and catch delivery or quality risks before they hit send dates. You'll also keep improving how the team works — processes, tools, handovers — without waiting to be asked. A team that feels clear and supported Regular 1:1s, honest consistent feedback, and being the person designers come to when they're stuck. You'll monitor workload alongside the Traffic Manager, contribute to hiring, and make sure new designers land well and ramp fast. What Success Looks Like Our brands feel like systems, and the work looks consistent wherever it shows up. Designers work to shared standards, so the same feedback isn't going round in circles. Work ships with reliable quality and far less rework. AI is a dependable part of how we create, not a gamble. The team feels supported, knows what good looks like, and trusts their own judgement. What We’re Looking For A direct, easy communicator who does well in a fast-moving, remote team. 5+ years of professional digital design experience, with a strong portfolio of digital work. A track record of building systems, such as templates, brand guidelines, component libraries, or repeatable processes, not just strong one-off work. Experience mentoring or supporting other designers; leadership is a big plus, not a must. A sharp eye for detail and the ability to give feedback that is clear, kind, and useful. Hands-on experience taming AI creative tools, or a strong point of view on how you would. Why you will love it You'll thrive in our high-pace, high-growth environment where your curiosity directly shapes million-dollar decisions. Every insight you uncover translates into real business impact, while you build and lead a team that thinks strategically about the brands they own. You'll have the freedom to innovate your approach to analysis while working at the cutting edge of gaming analytics and machine learning. Equal Opportunities Statement We hire based on skills, drive, and ideas — nothing else. Your background, gender, age, race, ethnicity, disability, sexual orientation, religion, neurodiversity, or educational path will never be a barrier to joining us. We also welcome candidates from non-traditional career journeys and value diverse perspectives that challenge conventional thinking. Diversity fuels our innovation, collaboration, and growth, and we're committed to creating an environment where everyone can contribute their best work and thrive. To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/b2spin-digital-design-team-lead-retention-crm

title: Beefree : Sale Manager (SaaS)
description: Headquarters: San Francisco URL: https://beefree.io Salary: $165,000 - $185,000 OTE Bonus: $75,000 Total OTE: $240,000 - $260,000 Remote from anywhere in the United States (Open to candidates in Canada and Mexico. This salary range applies to US-based candidates; compensation for candidates outside the US will be adjusted to reflect local market conditions.) Your mission is to turn Beefree’s sales motion into a repeatable, well-coached, well-instrumented revenue system. Beefree has two, distinct product lines: Beefree SDK, an embeddable content creation platform, and RGE Studio, an email production suite under our Really Good Emails brand. Your primary focus will be Beefree SDK, our most strategic sales-led business. It is a technical, consultative sale into SaaS and other companies, typically involving product, engineering, and commercial stakeholders. Because the SDK becomes embedded in our customers’ products, successful deals require strong discovery, multi-threaded account management, and the ability to build trust around long-term product and business impact. To succeed, you will need to lead by example and stay close to the work. You will be directly involved in selected strategic opportunities, support the team on complex deals, and use those learnings to improve how we qualify, sell, coach, and scale. This is not a pure management role. It is also not a senior AE role with a leadership title. We are looking for someone who still loves the game as much as they love developing others. The right person will help grow the business directly, and at the same time build the coaching, standards, and operating rhythm that make the team stronger over time. Your core responsibilities will be to: Lead and support strategic opportunities, especially for Beefree SDK, helping reps with discovery, deal strategy, stakeholder management, technical buyer alignment, and commercial execution. Coach the team helping them win live deals, not just reviewing them afterwards. Own and improve the playbooks for the sales team: talk tracks, qualification, demo flows, follow-up standards. Make the sales motion more repeatable and scalable across the full opportunity lifecycle. Run a clear operating rhythm for pipeline, forecasting and deal reviews, without over-engineering the process. Build an exceptional partnership with Product and Marketing to sharpen buyer narratives, improve campaign handoffs, and create shared visibility into pipeline health. How you will work: Lead through direct involvement, not distance. You will stay close enough to customers, prospects, and active deals to develop a deep understanding of what problems they are trying to solve, what other solutions they are considering, and how we best fit in. Support strategic opportunities, helping reps with discovery, demos, stakeholder mapping, technical buyer alignment, follow-up, negotiation, and close plans. Use that exposure to raise the quality of the team’s execution, from discovery and demos to stakeholder mapping, follow-up, negotiation, and close plans. Create clarity around what good looks like, through practical standards, simple processes, useful playbooks, and consistent coaching. Work closely with Product, Ops, and Marketing to identify and prioritize high-intent accounts. Use CRM data, pipeline reviews, win/loss signals, and customer feedback to decide where to focus, what to fix, and what to stop doing. Work closely with Marketing and Product to make sure the sales narrative, enablement material, case studies, and customer feedback loop reflect what buyers actually care about. Bring discipline to planning, forecasting, pipeline quality, and budget allocation, without turning the team into a process-heavy organization. What success looks like in the first 6 to 12 months: You have personally won strategic deals and set a standard the team can copy. The New Business pipelines are healthier, better qualified and easier to inspect. Deals have clearer next steps, stakeholder mapping and strategy. The team runs on a consistent coaching and review rhythm. The SDK narrative is sharper for both technical and business buyers. Win/loss learning feeds messaging, targeting and product feedback. Leadership has clearer visibility into pipeline quality and forecast confidence. What we are looking for: A seller who became a leader and never stopped selling A recent track record of personally closing technical, developer-led or PLG deals. What you have closed lately matters more than years on a CV. SaaS sales leadership experience, ideally in martech, developer tools or technical SaaS. Sharp with CRM data, funnel metrics and pipeline analysis, using data to decide, not just report A genuine coach who builds judgement, not script-followers. Remote leadership capability: clarity, energy and accountability in a distributed team Strong communicator across calls, demos, executive conversations and webinars Fluent in PLG: You know how to read product signals and partner across the organization to build sales-assist motions that support them. Real curiosity in the jobs Beefree’s products get done and an authentic passion for the company’s mission Extra points for experience selling to technical buyers. Comfortable with APIs, embedded software, production versus staging, Model Context Protocol and agentic UX. To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/beefree-sale-manager-saas

title: Big Bear Vacations: Owner Retention Specialist
description: Headquarters: Big Bear Lake, California, USA URL: https://www.bigbearvacations.com/ OWNER EXPERIENCE SPECIALIST Department: Owner Relations / Owner Experience Market: Puerto Vallarta & Nuevo Vallarta, Mexico Reports To: Director of Owner Relations Employment Type: Contractor Work Arrangement: 100% Remote / Monday - Saturday Compensation: USD $1,200 monthly Languages: Fluent English and Spanish, written and spoken — required Position Purpose The Owner Experience Specialist is the primary point of contact between Naya Homes and our homeowners in Puerto Vallarta and Nuevo Vallarta. This role is responsible for building and maintaining strong, consistent, and proactive relationships with homeowners in order to support owner satisfaction and retention. Rather than simply reacting to problems after they occur, the Specialist is expected to identify potential concerns early and address them before they become reasons for an owner to consider terminating their relationship with Naya Homes. The Specialist owns three key outcomes: executing the required owner communication cadence under the 33-Touch Relationship Model; providing homeowners with clear visibility into the condition and performance of their properties; and capturing property content that supports marketing efforts, social media, and owner communication. The successful candidate will be highly organized, proactive, customer-focused, and comfortable managing a high volume of daily communication while maintaining accurate documentation and consistent follow-up. Fluency in both English and Spanish, written and spoken, is an indispensable requirement for this position. The Specialist will communicate with homeowners and internal teams in both languages. Because this is a remote contractor position, the primary focus is on achieving established goals, service standards, and KPIs. The schedule may be flexible as needed to ensure objectives are met, while maintaining the required availability and responsiveness for homeowners and the business. Core Responsibilities 1. Owner Relationship Management & Communication Execute 20–25 documented owner interactions per day through calls, email, and text. Maintain 100% completion of required monthly touches for every assigned owner under the 33-Touch Relationship Model. Maintain a balance across the three touch types: Property Visibility: condition updates, inspection findings, photos, and property content. Personal Relationship: relationship-building communication not directly related to a transaction or problem. Informative / Value-Driven: performance, pricing, market conditions, and seasonal outlook. Enter every interaction with a clear purpose and conclude it with a defined next step. Complete scheduled owner check-in calls on the day they are due and rebook any rescheduled calls before the end of the same business day. Maintain clear communication regarding availability, support, and expected response times so owners always know who to contact and when they can expect an answer. Build trust and maintain professional, long-term relationships with homeowners. 2. Property Visibility & Owner Updates Collect property updates from Operations, Housekeeping, Maintenance, and inspection reports. Review condition notes and available photos before communicating with owners to ensure updates are specific and accurate. Translate operational findings into clear, plain-language owner updates, including what was found, what action is being taken, associated costs, and expected resolution timelines. Respond to all open owner conversations regarding work orders. Ensure that no work order is dispatched to an owner's property without documented owner approval. Ensure that every unresolved property issue has a clearly assigned next action and responsible person. Provide owners with meaningful visibility into the work being performed on their property. 3. Escalation & Churn Risk Identification Identify early signs of owner dissatisfaction or potential churn, including declining sentiment, slow or short responses, revenue complaints, recurring property condition issues, questions regarding contract terms, or references to other management companies. Escalate concerns on the same business day. Add applicable owners to the Owner Churn Board and keep records current as situations develop. Confirm ownership of the next action for every escalation and ensure each open case has a clearly assigned responsible person. Communicate potential risks early rather than waiting for issues to escalate. 4. Documentation & CRM Discipline Log every owner interaction in Monday.com on the same day it occurs. Maintain the Owner Churn Board on a daily basis. Schedule all future owner touches and follow-ups before closing out the day. Prepare a clear next-day action list before logging off. Complete a weekly CRM documentation self-audit and correct any gaps identified. Maintain accurate, complete, and timely records of all owner communications. Daily Operating Rhythm Start of Day Log into RingCentral and Monday.com. Review the Owner Engagement Tracker. Identify owners due for required touches. Review notes from inspections, maintenance, turnovers, and operations. Flag owners with open concerns, negative or declining sentiment, or recent performance or condition issues. During the Day Complete scheduled owner check-in calls. Send required emails and text messages. Complete scheduled property-content activities remotely or through available internal resources. Collect and communicate relevant property updates. Respond to open work order conversations. Escalate concerns on the same business day. Maintain consistent follow-up with assigned homeowners. End of Day Ensure all owner interactions are documented in Monday.com. Update the Owner Churn Board. Schedule future touches and follow-ups. Confirm that there are zero undocumented conversations. Prepare the next-day action list. Weekly Close Maintain 100% progress toward required monthly owner touches. Ensure there are no missed follow-ups. Complete the CRM documentation self-audit. Review owner sentiment trends. Identify unresolved owner issues requiring attention. Identify owners requiring proactive outreach during the following week. Performance Standards & KPIs Performance will be measured monthly against the following targets: Daily owner touches: 20–25 per day. Required monthly touch completion: 100%. Documentation accuracy: 95% or higher. Undocumented conversations: Zero. Same-day escalation compliance: 100%. Overdue escalations beyond SLA: Zero. Owner sentiment trend: Stable or improving. Overall KPI attainment: 90% or higher. Retention saves: Tracked and reviewed through the Owner Churn Board. Sustained performance below the established targets may result in a documented coaching plan. Accountability Standards Missed follow-ups are considered a performance issue. Undocumented conversations are considered a performance issue. Dispatching a work order without documented owner approval is considered a performance issue. Early escalation is considered a positive behavior and is recognized accordingly. Proactive communication is an expectation of the role, not an additional benefit or optional activity. The Specialist is expected to take ownership of assigned conversations, follow-ups, and open issues through resolution or appropriate escalation. Qualifications Required Fluent English and Spanish, both written and spoken — indispensable. 2+ years of experience in client-facing account management, hospitality, property management, customer success, or a related field. Demonstrated experience working independently and managing responsibilities in a remote environment. Strong CRM discipline and a proven track record of documenting work consistently without requiring constant follow-up. Comfortable initiating a high volume of outbound calls and handling difficult conversations directly and professionally. Excellent written and verbal communication skills in both English and Spanish. Strong interpersonal skills and the ability to build trust with clients and maintain long-term relationships. Highly organized and detail-oriented, with the ability to manage multiple conversations, follow-ups, and priorities simultaneously. Proactive approach to identifying potential dissatisfaction and escalating concerns appropriately. Ability to shoot and edit short-form vertical video using a phone and tools such as CapCut, Instagram, or equivalent. Strong computer skills and ability to work independently with digital communication, CRM, and collaboration tools. Reliable internet connection and a suitable home-office environment for remote work. Preferred Previous experience in short-term rentals, vacation rentals, hospitality, or property management. Working knowledge of Streamline VRS, Monday.com, or comparable PMS/CRM platforms. Experience producing content for Instagram, TikTok, Airbnb, or other property marketing platforms. Understanding of owner statements, management fees, and short-term rental revenue basics. Familiarity with the Puerto Vallarta / Nuevo Vallarta vacation rental market. Key Attributes The ideal candidate will be: Reliable and consistent: Able to perform repetitive activities consistently and accurately. Calm and professional: Comfortable dealing with frustrated homeowners without becoming defensive or over-promising. Highly organized: Capable of managing 20–25 daily conversations while maintaining complete follow-up. Proactive: Identifies potential issues early and takes action before they escalate. Accountable: Communicates problems honestly and takes ownership of mistakes. Relationship-oriented: Genuinely interested in understanding homeowners, their properties, and their needs. Adaptable: Comfortable working independently in a remote environment and managing priorities without constant supervision. Strong communicator: Able to communicate clearly and professionally in both English and Spanish. First 90 Days Days 1–30 Complete access and onboarding for Monday.com, Streamline, RingCentral, and the Owner Engagement Tracker. Become confident using the required systems and communication tools. Review the assigned owner portfolio. Make introductory contact with assigned homeowners. Complete shadowing and initial training. Days 31–60 Execute the full daily communication volume of 20–25 owner touches. Maintain 100% documentation compliance. Demonstrate consistent follow-up and proactive communication. Begin independently identifying and escalating owner concerns. Days 61–90 Achieve overall KPI attainment of 90% or higher. Own at least one owner retention case from identification through resolution or successful escalation. Demonstrate consistent owner relationship management and CRM discipline. Contribute repeatable content formats or communication practices that can be adopted by other Specialists. This job description outlines the primary duties and standards of the role and is not an exhaustive list of all responsibilities. Duties may be adjusted according to business needs. Workload structure, escalation pathways, and coaching practices will be administered in accordance with applicable company policies and requirements. description: Headquarters: Remote ZoomInfo is where careers accelerate. We move fast, think boldly, and empower you to do the best work of your life. You’ll be surrounded by teammates who care deeply, challenge each other, and celebrate wins. With tools that amplify your impact and a culture that backs your ambition, you won’t just contribute. Head of Data Partnerships Location: Waltham, MA | Vancouver, WA | Bethesda, MD | Remote (US) (Hybrid) ZoomInfo is seeking a Head of Data Partnerships to own how we grow our data advantage through external relationships. Our advantage is built on what we acquire as much as what we build - and this role owns the full range of ways we acquire: what we license, what we co-develop, what we trade for, what we sell alongside, and what we should own outright. Most of this is buying data, and buying it well. You will run a portfolio of hundreds of suppliers spanning company, contact, identity, and signal data across global markets - deciding which partners we invest in, which we consolidate, and which we walk away from, accountable for the coverage, accuracy, and unit economics of the whole thing. But the highest-value work is not a purchase order. It is the first-look arrangement that keeps a category away from a competitor. The revenue share that turns a cost line into a business. The co-sell motion that puts a partner's sellers in front of our buyers, and ours in front of theirs. The acquisition thesis that says this supply is too strategic to rent. You will identify those opportunities, structure them, and drive them to signature. You are equally comfortable interrogating an evaluation result and negotiating a term sheet — you design the proof that tells us whether a partner's data is actually net-new, build the business case, and run the commercial conversation to close. Success here is not deals signed. It is data availability delivered and value created: measurable improvements in coverage and quality that customers feel, revenue from partnerships that earn it, and a cost per record that gets better every year. What You'll Do (Essential Functions) Own the multi-year data supply and partnership strategy - maintain a live view of the global data market by domain and geography. Know who is emerging, who is consolidating, and where our next structural advantage comes from. Bring a point of view, not a vendor list. Make the build-buy-partner-acquire call - decide when ZoomInfo should license a source, co-develop it, structure an exclusive, build the capability internally, or pursue it as an acquisition. Defend that recommendation to executive leadership. Build and run co-sell and joint GTM motions with strategic partners, in partnership with Sales, Product Marketing, and Alliances - from the commercial construct through enablement and pipeline accountability. Source and shape acquisition opportunities - identify suppliers where owning the asset beats renting it, develop the thesis, and partner with Corporate Development through diligence and integration planning. Own the supplier portfolio end-to-end and its economics - sourcing, evaluation, onboarding, renewal, and rationalization; total portfolio cost, cost per usable record, and consolidation targets. Kill or renegotiate what is not earning its place. Design and run rigorous evaluations — define the test, measure net-new lift and accuracy against our own corpus, and produce a recommendation with numbers behind it. A partner's coverage claims are a hypothesis, not evidence. Represent ZoomInfo to partner executives - build the senior relationships that make us the first call when a partner has something worth bringing. Move deals through Legal, Privacy, Security, and Procurement without losing momentum, and ensure every source we ingest is compliant with GDPR, CCPA, and regional data protection requirements. Own the outcome after signature - partner with product and data teams through ingestion, matching, and publishing; keep the portfolio's single source of truth current; measure each partnership's impact and retire the ones that can't show it. What You Bring Required Qualifications 8+ years in data partnerships, strategic partnerships, business development, or data acquisition, with direct ownership of external relationships and their commercial outcomes Proven track record negotiating and closing third-party data agreements, including non-standard constructs — revenue share, reciprocal exchange, co-development, exclusivity, or joint go-to-market Demonstrated strategic judgment — has built a supply or partnership strategy for a category, not just executed against a requirements list Hands-on analytical ability — can independently interrogate an evaluation result, challenge a methodology, and tell the difference between a real coverage gain and a well-presented one Deep understanding of B2B data domains - firmographics, contact, identity, intent, technographics - how quality is measured (coverage, accuracy, freshness, match rate), and experience designing and defending structured evaluations Working fluency with data privacy frameworks (GDPR, CCPA) and how they constrain data sourcing, usage, and redistribution Commercial ownership - has carried a spend envelope or partnership P&L and made hard consolidation or termination calls Executive presence and cross-functional leadership - credible with a CDO or CFO audience and with partner executives; drives outcomes across product, engineering, sales, legal, and procurement without formal authority; writes a business case an executive will sign and a finding an engineer will trust Preferred Qualifications Background in business development, corporate strategy, or M&A - including sourcing, diligence, or integration of a data asset Has run a co-sell or alliance motion with revenue accountability, not just a partnership agreement Experience acquiring global data - regional suppliers, public business registries, non-US contact and company sources - and the compliance nuances that come with them Familiarity with multi-source enrichment economics (waterfalls, per-match pricing) and the identity data ecosystem Has built a partnership or vendor management operating system, not just inherited one Who Thrives Here You think in multi-year positions, not in deals. You can hold two things at once - the strategic case for why a partnership matters to where we're going, and the hard-nosed read on whether the data is actually any good. When a partner tells you they have 40 million records you don't yet have, your instinct is to design the test that proves or disproves it, not to build a slide about it. You are comfortable telling a partner no, comfortable telling your own leadership that a deal we already signed isn't working, and just as comfortable walking into a partner's executive team and proposing something neither company has done before. You would rather run one partnership all the way to measurable impact than manage twenty relationships that produce meetings. #LI-Hybrid #LI-Remote Actual compensation offered will be based on factors such as the candidate’s work location, qualifications, skills, experience and/or training. title: Postman: Corporate Solutions Engineer, Nordics
description: Headquarters: Remote, Denmark Who Are We? Postman is the world’s leading API platform, used by more than 45 million+ developers and 500,000 organizations, including 98% of the Fortune 500. Postman is helping developers and professionals across the globe build the API-first world by simplifying each step of the API lifecycle and streamlining collaboration—enabling users to create better APIs, faster. The company is headquartered in San Francisco and has offices in Boston, New York, Austin, Tokyo, London, and Bangalore - where Postman was founded. Postman is privately held, with funding from Battery Ventures, BOND, Coatue, CRV, Insight Partners, and Nexus Venture Partners. Learn more at postman.com or connect with Postman on X via @getpostman. P.S: We highly recommend reading The "API-First World" graphic novel to understand the bigger picture and our vision at Postman. The Opportunity With so many organizations using Postman, we are looking for an exceptional Corporate Solutions Engineer to join our team & help us support the growth of our customers in the corporate market. You will partner with our corporate sales team to promote an API-first development culture, nurture customer relationships, and guide Postman users in leveraging our platform to build their APIs most effectively. Ideally, we are looking for someone who lives & breathes APIs, has experience in corporate sales, is comfortable with JavaScript & is an expert Postman user already! In addition to working with a product that customers already know and love, our sales, customer success, product, and engineering teams will support you well in this role. What You’ll Do Help drive sales by nurturing prospects & supporting customers in our corporate market Conduct discovery, qualification, technical demos, & proof of value workshops with prospective customers looking to embrace Postman for their API lifecycle Handle Postman technical questions or objections & provide solutions or workarounds to address customer needs Produce reusable collateral that can be distributed to help our prospective customers understand how to adopt API-first practices with Postman. Understand deeply our customer workflows today & how they can adopt API-first development best practices Share customer feedback with appropriate teams & provide general customer advocacy Remain up-to-date with the competitive landscape, current trends, & challenges in the API market Create proof of concept integrations, tooling, & workflows as needed to support prospective customers Maintain & develop customer sandbox environments & best practices for working with the product Act as a technical intermediary between sales & other teams to best fit our customer needs About You 4+ years of corporate sales/solutions engineering experience 3+ years of software development experience 3+ API’s and Data platforms experience Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, a related field, or relevant work experience Ability to travel up to 25% Loves teamwork & collaboration in a fast-paced environment Customer-facing experience & comfortable engaging all levels of technologists, including individual developers, QA, product, & engineering leaders Strong understanding of APIs, & experience with producing & consuming APIs across different domains Strong knowledge of modern development methodologies & DevOps with an appreciation of the software development life cycle Comfortable with the SaaS sales process & common security concerns of cloud services Experience executing sales strategies & sales methodologies like MEDDIC, Challenger Sale, Command of the Message, etc. Excellent listener who seeks to understand what a customer is trying to achieve rather than pre-supposing solutions Familiar with typical developer tooling: IDEs, Git, CI/CD, monitoring services, microservices, containers, cloud computing services, etc. Fast learner, excited & willing to learn new technology on an ongoing basis Excellent communication skills (presentation, verbal & written) What Else? In addition to Postman's pay-on-performance philosophy, and a flexible schedule working with a fun, collaborative team, Postman offers a comprehensive set of benefits, including full medical coverage, flexible PTO, wellness reimbursement, and a monthly lunch stipend. Along with that, our wellness programs will help you stay in the best of your physical and mental health. Our frequent and fascinating team-building events will keep you connected, while our donation-matching program can support the causes you care about. We’re building a long-term company with an inclusive culture where everyone can be the best version of themselves. At Postman we value in person collaboration. We are in office 5 days a week for all roles based out of our hubs in San Francisco Bay Area, Boston, Austin, New York City, Tokyo and London. For roles based in Bangalore, employees currently work in the office three days a week and will transition to five days per week by the end of the year. We were thoughtful in our approach which is based on collaboration and grounded in feedback from our workforce, leadership team, and peers. The benefits of our in office model will be shared knowledge, brainstorming sessions, communication, and building trust in-person that cannot be replicated via zoom. In our work, we focus on specific goals that add up to a larger vision. Our inclusive work culture ensures that everyone is valued equally as important pieces of our final product. title: Animalz: Senior Content Marketer, SEO
description: Headquarters: San Diego, California URL: https://animalz.co We're looking for a Senior Content Marketer: an exceptional writer with the editorial judgment to own content quality for the customers they serve. This is a writing-first role. About 70% of your time will be spent researching and writing content yourself—work that calls for real research, original thinking, and craft. On the SEO team, that writing is built to perform in search: blog posts, guides, and landing pages that satisfy search intent and still read like something a person wanted to write. Search itself is changing, and this role sits right in the middle of that change. Alongside traditional rankings, you'll help customer content get found and cited by AI search tools like ChatGPT, Perplexity, and Google's AI Overviews. The rest of your time goes to making sure everything else your accounts publish is just as good as what you write. You'll manage the freelance writers who contribute to your accounts, keep the content calendar on track, review every piece before it reaches the customer, and ensure customer feedback is acted on and remembered. You won't do any of this alone. Every account is served by a small team, and you'll work alongside teammates who own the overall strategy and the customer relationship. Your ownership is the content itself: writing much of it, and standing behind all of it. What You'll Do Write high-quality content designed to rank , weaving keyword research, search intent, and on-page best practices into genuinely good writing, grounded in a real understanding of each customer's product and audience Review every piece your accounts deliver before it reaches the customer, whether you wrote it, a freelancer wrote it, or it started as an AI-assisted draft. (Note: we have separate Editors who edit pieces in production for feedback. Your role is the final review) Refresh and optimize existing content to improve rankings , engagement, and visibility, in both traditional search and AI-powered discovery Diagnose why a piece isn't performing , using tools like GA4, Google Search Console, and Ahrefs, and recommend clear, prioritized improvements Help manage the freelance writers on your accounts , write briefs they can succeed with, and maintain customer brand guides and other assets for reference. Act on customer feedback quickly and thoroughly , and keep track of it, so a customer never has to give the same note twice Communicate directly with customers about deliverables , timelines, and revisions, and join customer calls as a trusted voice on the work Help improve our AI-assisted content workflows by using them on real work and feeding back what you learn Contribute to performance reporting , helping show customers what shipped, how it's performing, and what we're learning Use AI tools thoughtfully, taking advantage of them where they genuinely help, and applying your own judgment and craft where they don't Contribute to team knowledge-sharing and internal initiatives , learning from teammates and sharing what you know What We're Looking For 4–6 years of experience in content marketing , with at least 2 of those years in B2B SaaS. Agency experience can be a plus Exceptional writing ability : You're first and foremost a writer. You produce publication-ready content with minimal revisions, writing with clarity, precision, and strategic insight, and you adapt your voice to different brands while keeping your standards high Strong editorial judgment : You can read someone else's draft, explain clearly why it does or doesn't work. You catch quality problems before customers do Deep SEO knowledge: You're fluent in keyword research, on-page optimization, content audits, and competitive analysis, and you can diagnose why a piece isn't ranking and what to do about it Growing AEO fluency: You understand how AI-driven search is changing content visibility, and you're actively building hands-on skills in making content surface well in AI tools Familiarity with SEO and analytics tools such as GA4, Google Search Console, Ahrefs, and Clearscope (or their equivalents) Experience working with other writers: You've briefed, edited, or managed freelancers or teammates Customer communication skills: You're clear, responsive, and trustworthy with customers, and you build confidence through the quality and reliability of your work Strong organizational skills: You can manage multiple accounts, contributors, and deadlines at once without letting quality or dates slip AI fluency : You use AI tools to support your workflow responsibly and effectively, you can edit AI-assisted drafts to publication quality, and you stay current on emerging best practices Technical curiosity : You genuinely enjoy learning how software products and businesses work so you can write about them with authority Ownership and adaptability: You take initiative, navigate ambiguity, and raise problems early, while they're still easy to solve Room to Grow Senior Content Marketers at Animalz have real room to grow. You'll start by taking ownership of content for a small set of customers, then take on bigger and more complex accounts as you're ready. From there, many people grow into leading content strategy or managing customer relationships—first alongside a senior teammate, then independently—which is the path to our Associate Head of Content role. Others go deep instead: our most experienced Senior Content Marketers lead content for our most demanding customers and mentor newer teammates, and that's a career here in its own right. Whichever direction you grow, you'll keep writing. Even our most senior people do; it's the heart of what we sell. Your First Few Months You'll spend your first weeks learning our processes and editorial standards and getting to know your accounts, writing your first pieces with plenty of editorial support. Over your first few months, you'll step into full content ownership of your first account (with your Head of Content close by as a backstop) and grow from there at a pace that matches your experience. Our Values At Animalz, our values guide how we show up for our customers, our teammates, and the content we create. Value Over Vanity : Success isn't measured in customer praise, but in the growth outcomes we deliver for them. Two Steps Ahead : Great service means addressing a need or issue before it becomes notable. Power Source, Not Power Trip : We find our greatest impact in being in service to others—our customers, our customers' customers, and one another. True power comes not from authority but from influence. Pursue Mastery : Through deliberate practice and open collaboration, we build expertise that elevates both our work and our ability to deliver transformative results for our clients. Left Brain, Right Brain, Robot Brain : We create extraordinary outcomes by combining empathy and creativity, data and research, and algorithms and AI. In the Arena : We don't advise from the sidelines – we're active practitioners who shape the future of our industry through bold experimentation and continuous learning. Working Arrangements Location : Fully remote (Americas or EMEA) Timezone Requirements : At least 4 hours of overlap with US timezones (EST/PST) to collaborate effectively with our team and customers Compensation & Benefits Salary Range : $70,000 – $85,000 USD annually Placement within the range is based on experience, skills, and demonstrated impact in previous content marketing roles. Unlimited PTO policy Flexible working schedule Technology stipend Learning stipend Health & wellness stipend Team lunch stipend Health & vision insurance (US only) 401(k) retirement plan (US only) Diversity, Equity & Inclusion At Animalz, we believe diverse perspectives make us stronger. We're committed to building an inclusive workplace where people of all backgrounds, experiences, and identities can thrive. We particularly encourage applications from historically underrepresented groups in tech and marketing. Equal Opportunity Animalz is an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate based on race, religion, color, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, status as a protected veteran, status as an individual with a disability, or other applicable legally protected characteristics. title: Ellipsis®: Accounts Lead (Remote, UK/EU - £60-65k)
description: Headquarters: Oxford, UK URL: https://getellipsis.com Ellipsis is emerging as a market leader in “GEO” for B2B technology companies. This is a high-impact, hands-on role in a fast-moving and ambitious agency. Description The transition to AI search has put a lot of the SEO industry on the back foot. Ellipsis has always been consultative/strategic in our approach, we started building AI search products in 2021 on GPT-2, and thus this has been a time for us to thrive. Today, we think we have a better understanding of AI search than almost anyone else. We have both the tracking product (built in-house), the data (~25 million AI answers for analysis, with more tracked weekly), and the execution end-to-end from strategy, to writing, to in-house design, to optimization, and performance reporting. This is a new role that further builds out our commercial function. You will be joining us at a very exciting time. What you will own You will own Ellipsis’ client relationships. Every client should always know what we're doing, why, and what it's achieving -- without having to ask. The book should grow through renewals, expansions, referrals, and case studies. Ellipsis is an AI search agency, and our customers are predominantly B2B technology companies. We work with a lot of startups and scale-ups; B2B tech has been our bread-and-butter although we are also having success with B2C and have some very high profile clients in this area. We are UK-based but fully remote and have been since day 1, 8 years ago. A lot of the team is UK based, our core business hours are UK, but we are fully remote and there is no location requirement for this role. Our clients are a mix of UK, Europe, and US-based. Sales and delivery are working well. The gap is the layer in between: after a client signs, nobody formally owns the relationship; the story of what we’re doing and why, the communications, the renewals, the expansion conversations. Today that’s informally covered by the MD/ Founder, which caps how much the business can grow and means things slip during busy periods. Your role will be to take this over, own key accounts, and have impact across the whole business. Success looks like retaining our customers, successfully expanding and renewing accounts, and collaborating tightly with Operations, Strategy, and Sales to further our continuous improvement and growth. You will report directly to the MD/ Founder and be expected to contribute as a senior leader in the team. Supporting signals will be seen in the day-to-day: clients are not chasing us to find out what’s happening, call prep and calls have a clear story running through the deck that you own, you are nudging Operations and Strategy to ensure the voice of the customer is heard internally; and expansions, case studies, and referrals happen because someone owns them. What you'd do Own the story for each client. What they bought, what they want, what we've done, what's next -- and tell it clearly. The team preps the data and analysis; you make it land. You own the narrative in client decks and calls. Run the communication rhythm. At the start of each week, quick updates to clients via Slack (what we did, what’s next, what’s blocked, performance highlights); ad-hoc comms throughout the week via email and Slack, and either monthly or fortnightly calls depending on the client. Understand our clients’ businesses so you can contribute and expand. Ellipsis has an extremely consultative sales process and our clients trust us as experts. In many instances, we’re brought in to do “GEO” but end up as a strategic marketing partner. This creates expansion opportunities which you can pursue as long as you understand their business and where we can contribute more -- expansion and adding value go hand-in-hand and we build for the long-term success of the business. Be curious about AI search and strategy. AI search is changing quickly and Ellipsis is leading that change. We are constantly producing new research, looking at data, and optimizing our approach. You will work with a Strategy Lead for each account (and the Head of Strategy across the business) but need to be curious, data literate, and capable of deeply understanding what we’re doing and why -- which will let you confidently hold the room when discussing strategy, and advocate for the client’s needs effectively. Front the key relationships. For the top ~8-10 accounts, you attend the calls and run the relationship. For the rest, you own the story, ensure internal alignment, and step in on renewals, risk, or expansion (Content Managers front the regular calls). Own renewals and expansions. Spot and shape upsell opportunities, run the renewal conversations, chase case-study permissions and referrals. You’ll need to both be able to smell adjacent opportunities (we are currently one of the few agencies that can do strategy, copy, and design for a “GEO friendly website”, but don’t advertise this enough!) and guide renewals/expansions (which are always inherently tied to strategy and what more we can do for the customer). Advocate for the client internally. When work is late or off-brief, you say so and chase it. You represent what the client actually asked for, even when that's uncomfortable. Report and contribute to planning internally. You’ll join (and lead part of) the Monday morning pipeline and accounts review meeting, where we plan upcoming business and assess the state of renewals and expansion opportunities with existing accounts. You’ll work closely with Operations to ensure we have the right capacity at the right time, and work closely with Sales to ensure you understand incoming prospects and are ready to advocate for their needs internally from day one. What this role is not Not a project manager or a status-updater. Not operations -- you flag delivery problems, the ops lead fixes processes. Not new-business sales -- acquisition is covered. Requirements You’ll have owned complex and commercially important client relationships. In other UK agencies this is typically a mid-to-senior “Accounts Director” or exceptional “Senior Accounts Manager” role but we’re open to other roles, industries, and experiences. Marketing or SEO agency experience is probably helpful. You will need to become fluent enough in SEO and AI search to hold the room with a technical, sceptical client -- you don't produce the analysis, but you can defend it; but we’re happy for you to pick this up quickly on the job. You should be commercially confident: happy to run a renewal and ask for the expansion. Warm with clients, firm internally. Compensation £60-65k There is no individual commission. Renewals and expansions at Ellipsis are team outcomes: Strategy, Content, Design and Operations create the value, while the Accounts Lead ensures clients understand it and leads the commercial conversation. We therefore pay a strong fixed salary and assess success through the long-term retention, health and growth of the client book. First 90 days Shadow the founder on the key accounts, then take them over one by one. Ship the onboarding protocol and monthly update rhythm. Baseline the retention numbers. By day 90, you own the top relationships and the founder attends client calls by exception only. To be successful at Ellipsis, you need to be able to think quickly from first principles, capable of executing quickly, and driven to succeed. Whilst we’re 8 years old, we operate like a startup. The team -- a lot of whom have been with us a long time -- will tell you this is a place to learn quickly, progress quickly, and do your best work. Your capability matters a lot more to us than your experience, and we would recommend you tailor your application with this in mind. We want to hear from you rather than ChatGPT. Please keep this in mind in particular with the screening questions. Benefits This is a full-time, 100% remote role (UK/EU based). Work from home, or the beach! We have a lot of clients in the US and California, so you'll need to be available for client and new business calls in the 5-7pm UK slot a couple of days a week (generally don't go later than this, but you'll need to be available as needed). 28 days of paid holiday An additional 1 paid holiday day a year with each year of tenure, up to a maximum of 5 additional days 4-day work week, once a month (instead of local bank holidays) Genuinely flexible working , although noting the meeting schedule requirements above Regular team retreats; last was Istanbul, previously in Edinburgh, Oxford, Madrid, and Budapest Enhanced maternity/paternity leave , and sick pay The application process It's important we find the best candidate for this position, and our selection process will reflect this. Much of our company Wiki is externally accessible, and you're encouraged to read through this before applying. We have a very useful guide to our interview process available here . This tells you what we're looking for and reading this will significantly increase your chance of success! We'll review applications on a rolling basis but interviews start after the closing date. There's thus no benefit to rushing to apply: we will bias heavily towards your application's answers rather than your CV, and we'd love for you to take your time. We're fortunate to receive a large volume of applications. You can make your application stand out by paying special attention to the main responsibilities of this role, and "how to apply". If you think you're a fit, or could be a fit – go for it! We use video calls for interviews. You'll have video interviews using Google Meet, including with members of the Leadership team and the Founder. We understand that this is as much you interviewing us, as the other way round. Throughout the interview process, we're extremely happy to answer your questions about the business, working here, and the future of the company. The final stage of our hiring process is a paid test project, which will be similar to work you could expect to do if you were hired. We'll give you a week to complete the project, and expect it to be 4-6 hours of work. Following the completion of trial projects, we'll ask for professional references from your previous 2 managers. We ask candidates to introduce us to their references, for a 10 minute call. We do great work for clients and are building an ethical business that lets everyone do their best work. If you think you could be the next person to join our team, please apply :) How to apply Please apply through Workable: https://apply.workable.com/getellipsis . We will decide who progresses to the next stage based on the form you submit, and your CV. Please give us a good reason to select you! Taking the time to research the role, what we're looking for, what we do, and what you can do for us will increase your chance of success. Your cover letter is where you have the space to do this. Ellipsis is an equal opportunity workplace and is committed to equal employment opportunity. The deadline for submission is the end of the day, on 13 September 2026. To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/ellipsis-accounts-lead-remote-uk-eu-60-65k

For each example, state exactly what you did and explain the audience, angle, hook, and intended next step in the funnel. Share any useful performance context you are permitted to disclose. Redacted evidence is acceptable. Show one weak or failed creative and explain what you learned or changed. Choose one Meta ad you respect, explain why it works, and describe the next three variants you would test. State your location, timezone, availability, and expected monthly compensation after the trial. Applications without the requested evidence will not be reviewed. Shortlisted candidates will complete a small paid practical exercise before the 30-day trial. title: OnePet: Senior Off-Page SEO & Link Building Specialist
description: Headquarters: League City, Texas URL: http://one.pet OnePet is a portfolio of digitally native pet brands, including Total Vet, CertaPet, and Honest Paws. We help pet owners discover, decide, and purchase trustworthy products and services for their pets. We're looking for a highly resourceful Off-Page SEO & Link Building Specialist to own link acquisition and off-site authority building across 3-4 primary domains. This is a hands-on, high-autonomy role. We're looking for someone who can identify opportunities, decide how to attack them, and execute - not someone who needs a large team, detailed SOPs, or constant direction. Buying links can be a tactic. It cannot be your entire strategy. What You'll Do Your job is straightforward: build a stronger, more diverse, and more valuable backlink and off-site brand profile that contributes to higher rankings and more organic traffic. Creative link acquisition: Develop campaigns and angles that give publishers a real reason to link - original data, statistics, surveys, resources, visual assets, tools, awards, rankings, expert contributions, or ideas we haven't thought of yet. Digital PR & media outreach: Find newsworthy angles, identify journalists and publishers, pitch stories and expertise, and turn those relationships into coverage, links, and brand mentions. Traditional link building: Execute competitive link-gap analysis, reclamation, broken-link opportunities, unlinked mentions, resource outreach, guest contributions, partnerships, directories, and other proven tactics. Paid placements: Identify worthwhile opportunities, evaluate quality and risk, negotiate pricing and terms, and determine whether the expected value justifies the cost. GEO & brand visibility: Pursue relevant brand mentions, citations, and off-site signals that can improve visibility across ChatGPT, Google AI experiences, Perplexity, and other answer engines - not just traditional search. Experimentation: Continuously test new approaches while maintaining reliable campaigns that produce consistent results. Not every experiment needs to work. The overall program does. How You'll Operate You'll have substantial freedom to determine how you get results. We expect you to understand the backlink profiles of the sites you're responsible for, identify the biggest opportunities, communicate what you're pursuing, and then execute. Use AI heavily. Automate where it makes sense. Build relationships. Negotiate. Develop assets. Run outreach. Find creative shortcuts. Use whatever legitimate resources and processes help you produce better results. You will not be micromanaged. In return, you'll be accountable for outcomes. If an opportunity carries meaningful SEO, reputational, or financial risk, we expect you to recognize it and discuss the risk/reward with us before proceeding. Otherwise, use good judgment and keep moving. How We'll Measure Success The primary scorecard starts with high-quality referring domains, links, brand mentions, and citations acquired. Quality and relevance of referring domains Number and diversity of links acquired Brand mentions and AI/answer-engine citations Growth and quality of our backlink profiles Cost and value of paid acquisitions Performance of different campaigns and tactics The goal is improved rankings, search visibility, and organic traffic. We'll have lightweight weekly and monthly reporting, and you'll maintain enough structured tracking for us to understand which sources, tactics, and campaigns are producing the best results. What We're Looking For We care more about what you've accomplished than how many years you've been doing it. Acquire high-quality backlinks through multiple strategies - not just paid placements or mass outreach. Evaluate whether a backlink opportunity is genuinely valuable using data and judgment. Develop and execute creative link-building campaigns from idea through acquisition. Conduct effective outreach to journalists, bloggers, publishers, website owners, and partners. Evaluate and negotiate paid placements rather than simply accepting quoted prices. Use competitive backlink analysis, reclamation, prospecting, and other core off-page SEO techniques. Understand GEO/AEO and the growing importance of off-site brand mentions and citations. Use AI to dramatically increase your research, prospecting, outreach, analysis, and execution capacity. Run multiple campaigns independently and prioritize your time based on expected impact. Communicate effectively in English internally and externally. Know when to experiment, when to scale something that works, and when to stop wasting time on something that doesn't. We don't care what industry you've worked in. We don't care whether you learned link building at an agency, in-house, independently, or somewhere else. We care whether you can produce results. Tools & Resources Ahrefs Google Search Console SEO Gets Claude company subscription If another tool or resource will materially improve results, make the case for it. The same applies to campaign and link-acquisition spend. We don't have a rigid price we're willing to pay for a link. Budget follows value. Find the opportunity, evaluate it intelligently, negotiate it well, and tell us why it's worth the investment. The Role in One Sentence Own off-page SEO across several domains, attack link acquisition from multiple angles, use AI and your own resourcefulness to execute at a high level, and be accountable for measurable results. If that's already how you approach link building, we'd like to hear from you. To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/onepet-senior-off-page-seo-link-building-specialist

Strong communication skills and the ability to translate between technical and non-technical stakeholders. A track record of building: zero-to-one products, systems you left in a meaningfully better place, or hard problems you refused to let stay unsolved. Summary Temporal is hiring a Director, Global Developer Success to lead and scale our deeply technical support organization. This is a high-impact leadership role responsible for turning customer technical response into a repeatable, measurable, and differentiated advantage for Temporal. Developer Success is the team customers rely on when they need fast, confident support for complex developer and infrastructure issues. The next phase requires a leader who can preserve technical excellence and customer empathy while building the operational rigor of a world-class support function. Why this role exists Temporal's customers are building increasingly mission-critical, distributed, long-running, and AI-enabled systems. When something is unclear or broken, the support experience must be fast, technically credible, and predictable. Developer Success must scale beyond heroics. We need clear KPIs, tiering, queue management, escalation paths, incident communication standards, RCA practices, quality review, and talent development systems. Premium customer interactions increasingly happen across tickets, Slack, escalations, and incident channels. The support experience must have one clear operating model so customers, Sales, SAs, Platform Architects, Product, Engineering, and Support know who owns what and what good looks like. The support team must reduce avoidable Engineering escalations while ensuring real product defects, documentation gaps, and recurring customer pain reach Product and Engineering with high-quality signal. What you will do Build and lead Global Developer Success: Hire, coach, develop, retain, and performance-manage high-performing support engineers, managers, and specialists across tiers, regions, and customer segments. Create the support operating system: Define SLAs/OLAs, ticket and Slack triage, queue ownership, severity definitions, tiering, escalation paths, incident communications, RCA standards, quality review, staffing, and operating cadence. Raise the quality bar: Move beyond CSAT alone by measuring customer effort, touches to resolution, reopen rate, handoffs, recurrence, communication quality, resolution confidence, and customer-visible ownership. Harden Slack and customer response: Turn premium Slack response into a defined service model with acknowledgement standards, urgent paths, conversion-to-ticket rules, coverage model, manager review, and customer-facing expectations. Protect Engineering focus through better support: Reduce avoidable escalations by building runbooks, diagnostics, knowledge systems, reproducibility standards, technical triage, and high-quality escalation packets. Lead escalation and incident discipline: Establish crisp roles for technical lead, escalation manager, communications owner, Support, Engineering, SA, Platform Architecture, and Sales. Ensure incidents and critical escalations are communicated with clarity and followed by useful RCAs. Build technical depth and enablement: Create career paths, training, mentorship, certification, quality review, and hands-on learning that help junior engineers become senior/staff support engineers and help senior engineers scale their expertise. Partner across the company: Work closely with Product, Engineering, Sales, Solutions Architecture, Platform Architecture, Customer Success, Docs, DevRel, and Services to ensure support signal turns into product, documentation, enablement, and customer lifecycle improvements. Use tooling and AI pragmatically: Improve routing, deflection, summaries, analytics, knowledge surfacing, diagnostics, and customer communication while measuring real operating outcomes rather than tool adoption alone. Represent Temporal with customers: Engage directly in strategic escalations, high-stakes incidents, enterprise support conversations, QBR/EBR inputs, and executive readouts when support experience affects customer trust. What you will bring 12+ years of experience in technical support, customer engineering, SRE, solutions engineering, infrastructure engineering, or similar customer-facing technical roles, with 5+ years leading support or customer-facing engineering teams. Proven experience building and scaling technical support operations for a deeply technical B2B product, ideally in developer tools, cloud infrastructure, data platforms, observability, AI infrastructure, open source, or distributed systems within a GTM organization. Experience managing managers and building the systems that make teams run: metrics, operating cadence, queue management, quality review, staffing models, tiering, escalation paths, and performance management. Strong technical credibility with developers, support engineers, SREs, platform engineers, and product engineers. You can reason about APIs/SDKs, cloud-native infrastructure, Kubernetes, observability, distributed systems, reliability, incident response, and debugging workflows. Track record reducing avoidable Engineering escalations while improving the quality of product and engineering signal when escalations are needed. Deep understanding of support quality metrics: response time, resolution time, customer effort, touches, reopens, recurrence, backlog, SLA/OLA attainment, deflection, CSAT, sentiment, and case quality. Strong customer communication skills in high-pressure situations. You can write crisp updates, lead customer-facing RCA conversations, set expectations, and coach others to communicate clearly. Clear philosophy for hiring, onboarding, leveling, progression, coaching, retention, and performance management for technical support engineers and support managers. High ownership and builder mindset. You create clarity in ambiguous systems, ship v1 processes quickly, and iterate with data and customer evidence. Nice to haves Experience with Temporal, Cadence, workflow engines, orchestration systems, event-driven architecture, distributed applications, or production reliability tooling. Experience in consumption-based, open-source, developer-led, or mission-critical enterprise support motions. Energized by working within a GTM organization. Experience building Tier 3 / elite support, OSS/community support, self-hosted support, premium support, or 24/7 critical escalation coverage. title: Webflow: Staff Brand Designer
description: Headquarters: Remote URL: https://webflow.com/ Webflow is the agentic web marketing platform for modern marketing teams, helping organizations build, manage, and optimize high-performing web experiences that drive predictable growth and strengthen brand trust. Building at Webflow will need grit, because we move fast, without ever sacrificing craft or quality. We're looking for a Staff Brand Designer who works in the space between brand and web—someone who can hold a brand idea and build it themselves. Our marketing site is where most people meet Webflow, which makes it the primary surface of our brand rather than a place we put finished work. You'll design that experience and take it all the way into production on our own platform. The brand doesn't stop at the site, though—it shows up in campaigns, conference environments, film, and the product itself—and you'll work across those surfaces too. The border between those disciplines is disappearing in practice: a conference identity now ships as a motion system and a site in the same breath, and an announcement has to hold in a keynote and a viewport in the same week. This role also sits closest to the edge of what's newly possible, so we care most about someone who is already experimenting—putting AI and agentic tooling to real use and bringing back what holds up. You'll sit on Brand Studio, Webflow's in-house creative team, as a senior individual contributor working alongside brand designers, motion, and marketing partners. About the role: Location: Remote-first (United States; BC & ON, Canada) Full-time Permanent Exempt The cash compensation for this role is tailored to align with the cost of labor in different geographic markets. We've structured the base pay ranges for this role into zones for our geographic markets, and the specific base pay within the range will be determined by the candidate’s geographic location, job-related experience, knowledge, qualifications, and skills. United States (all figures cited below are in USD and pertain to workers in the United States) Zone A: $ 162,500 - $195,000 Zone B: $ 153,300 - $184,000 Zone C: $ 143,300 - $172,000 Canada (figures cited below are in CAD and pertain to workers in ON & BC, Canada) 177,000 - 213,000 This role is also eligible to participate in Webflow's company-wide bonus program. Target amounts are a percentage of base salary and vary by career level. Payouts are based on company performance against established financial and operational goals. Please visit our Careers page for more information on which locations are included in each of our geographic pay zones. However, please confirm the zone for your specific location with your recruiter. Application Information: Application deadline: applications accepted on an ongoing basis until position is closed and filled This posting is for an existing vacancy Reporting to the Manager, Brand Studio As a Staff Brand Designer, you'll… Design the web as our primary brand surface Treat webflow.com as the place most people meet the brand, and design it as an experience rather than a stack of sections. Shape pacing, narrative, and flow across a visitor's path, not just the layout of individual pages. Express the brand through behavior—type, motion, interaction, and state—not only through how a frame looks at rest. Extend the brand system into web-native patterns and components that other designers and marketers can use without you in the room. Work in the space between brand and web Design and build in the same motion, carrying work from brand idea to shipped page without handing it off at the seam. Act as the primary technical owner of Webflow's marketing surface area, from CMS architecture to component systems to publishing workflow. Build on Webflow as our most sophisticated customer, so the site stands as proof of what the platform can do rather than an exception to it. Hold the craft bar on brand expression and the technical bar on implementation at the same time, and know when the two are in tension. Make architectural calls that balance ambition against performance, scalability, and the cost of maintaining them a year from now. Ship launches, campaign pages, and fixes with speed and accuracy under real deadline pressure, including moments like Webflow Conf, and own performance, accessibility, and SEO health as ongoing commitments. Work across the brand's other surfaces Bring the same standard to work that isn't a website: campaign systems, conference environments, editorial, film, and the brand's expression inside the product. Design for coherence across surfaces, so an idea that starts on the site still holds up in a keynote, a video, or a physical space. Understand how a brand system has to behave differently in each medium, and help evolve the system itself rather than only its web expression. Experiment, and put what works into production Work in the open with AI-assisted design and development, generative code, and agentic build tooling, and bring back what actually holds up under a quality bar. Explore advanced and pre-release platform capabilities and ship them ahead of the market. Build the experiments that make an argument—a working prototype that settles a debate faster than a deck would. Use generative and agentic tooling where it closes the gap between designing a system and building it, which is increasingly the same act. Develop the team's practice as you go, so a tool you proved out this month is something everyone is using next month. Feed real practitioner insight back to Product and Engineering, because you're building on the thing we sell. Unblock the business Partner with Brand Studio, Product Marketing, Growth, Legal, and Events to get campaigns and launches live without compromising the site. Reduce dependency bottlenecks by making your expertise available early, when decisions are still cheap to change. Mentor designers and marketers through pairing, feedback, and the systems and guardrails you build for them. Translate technical constraints into plain language so non-technical partners can make good tradeoffs themselves. In addition to the responsibilities outlined above, at Webflow we will support you in identifying where your interests and development opportunities lie and we'll help you incorporate them into your role. About you: Requirements: BS/BA college degree or relevant experience 8+ years of experience spanning brand design and web design or development, with work that clearly shows both Demonstrated experience designing marketing websites as a primary surface of a brand—narrative, flow, and interaction across a journey, not just individual page layouts Deep, demonstrable Webflow expertise, including complex CMS structures, components, interactions, performance work, and system-level thinking Experience contributing to brand work beyond websites—campaigns, environments, editorial, motion, or product surfaces—with a view on how a brand system has to change shape in each Active AI fluency: you are already using AI and agentic tooling in real production work, and can show what you have built with it, what you have thrown away, and how you tell those apart Familiarity with code: you read HTML and CSS comfortably, can follow and adapt JavaScript, and are not stuck when a build needs to go past the visual editor. Professional development experience is not required. A portfolio that shows both identity-level craft and shipped, high-traffic sites you can speak to at the architecture level You’ll thrive as a Staff Brand Designer if you: Think about a website as an experience with pacing and narrative, rather than a set of pages to be laid out. Treat new tools as material to be tested rather than trends to have an opinion about, and can tell the difference between a capability and a demo. Move fluidly between a type-scale decision and a CMS schema decision, and consider neither beneath you nor outside your job. Are as interested in what the brand does in a room or a keynote as in what it does in a viewport. Like that the work is public evidence—people inspect how webflow.com is built to decide what the platform can do. Reach for a prototype before a deck, and would rather show the thing working than describe it. Think in systems first, and can explain why you structured something the way you did three releases later. Care about craft at the level of a 40ms transition and a 200-page class system in equal measure. Bring calm and clarity to complex, fast-moving launches, and would rather surface a risk early than absorb it quietly. Want meaningful technical ownership without formal people management, and get real satisfaction from scaling your impact through standards, tooling, and mentorship. Communicate well with people who don't share your vocabulary, and give feedback that makes work better rather than smaller. Have opinions about where the web is going as agents take on more of the building, and are already testing them in production. Stay curious and open to growth—demonstrating a proactive embrace of AI, and actively building and applying fluency in emerging technologies to elevate how we work, drive faster outcomes, and expand collective impact. Our Core Behaviors: Build lasting customer trust. We build trust by taking action that puts customer trust first. Win together. We play to win, and we win as one team. Success at Webflow isn't a solo act. Reinvent ourselves. We don't just improve what exists, we imagine what's possible. Own it all the way. We move fast because the moment demands it, and we hold ourselves accountable to deliver outcomes — for each other, and for customers. Benefits Ownership in what you help build. Every permanent Webflower receives equity (RSUs) in our growing, privately held company. Health coverage that actually covers you. Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision plans for full-time employees and their dependents, with Webflow covering most premiums. Support for every stage of family life . 12 weeks of paid parental leave for all parents and 6+ weeks of additional paid leave for birthing parents. Plus inclusive care for family planning, menopause, and midlife transitions. Time off that’s actually off. Flexible vacation, paid holidays, and a sabbatical program to help you recharge and come back inspired. Wellness for the whole you. Access to mental health resources, therapy and coaching. Invest in your future. A 401(k) with 100% employer match (up to $6,000/year) in the U.S., and support for retirement savings globally. Monthly stipends that flex with your life. Localized support for work and wellness expenses — from Wi-Fi to workouts. Bonus for building together. All full-time, permanent, non-commission employees are eligible for our annual WIN bonus program. Remote, together At Webflow, equality is a core tenet of our culture. We are an Equal Opportunity (EEO)/Veterans/Disabled Employer and are committed to building an inclusive global team that represents a variety of backgrounds, perspectives, beliefs, and experiences. Employment decisions are made on the basis of job-related criteria without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, veteran status, or any other classification protected by applicable law.
